475: function Trc = relay_currents_table_v2(Mtrx, TiJ)
476: %RELAY_CURRENTS_TABLE_V2  One row per finite matrix side + I0 context.
477: %   I_primary = I_secondary x CT_device (matrix sides are secondary amperes;
478: %   CTs are v2 15000/1600 via the graded matrix). Secondary arithmetic is
479: %   frozen phase5_ct (the single source of truth; the phase5_ct_table
480: %   wrapper rejects 1600 by locked guard and frozen files stay untouched).
481: %   I0_A joins real production Iseq0; LG-exact If/3 only when the join
482: %   truly lacks I0; LLG-without-Iseq0 -> NaN, never invented.
483: ml = tocell(Mtrx.fault_location); mt = tocell(Mtrx.fault_type); mc = tocell(Mtrx.caseID);
484: jl = tocell(TiJ.fault_location); jt = tocell(TiJ.fault_type); jc = tocell(TiJ.caseID);
485: Jseq = double(TiJ.Iseq0_kA(:)); Jtot = double(TiJ.I_primary_A(:));
486: oLoc = {}; oTyp = {}; oCase = {}; oDev = {}; oSide = {};
487: oIp = []; oIk = []; oCt = []; oIs = []; oI0 = []; oSrc = {};
488: oProv = {}; oScope = {};
489: PROV = ['SOURCE-BACKED:Phase-4-production-import-branch-through-current-via-frozen-phase5_coord;' ...
490:     'secondaries-via-frozen-phase5_ct-arithmetic-v2-CTs-15000-gen-1600-GSUT-GIS'];
491: for i = 1:height(Mtrx)
492:     j = find(strcmp(jc, mc{i}) & strcmp(jl, ml{i}) & strcmp(jt, mt{i}), 1, 'first');
493:     if isempty(j)
494:         error('phase5b_production:join', ...
495:             'relay-currents join missed %s %s %s.', mc{i}, ml{i}, mt{i});
496:     end
497:     if isfinite(Jseq(j))
498:         i0 = Jseq(j) * 1000;
499:         src = 'Iseq0-SOURCE-BACKED-Phase-4-production';
500:     elseif strcmp(mt{i}, 'LG')
501:         i0 = Jtot(j) / 3;
502:         src = 'LG-exact-If/3-DERIVED';
503:     else
504:         i0 = NaN;
505:         src = 'MISSING-no-Iseq0-LLG-neutral-counted-once-N/A';
506:     end
507:     if isfinite(Mtrx.I_down_A(i)) && isfinite(Mtrx.ct_down(i))
508:         oLoc{end + 1} = ml{i}; oTyp{end + 1} = mt{i}; oCase{end + 1} = mc{i}; %#ok<AGROW>
509:         oDev{end + 1} = Mtrx.downstream{i}; oSide{end + 1} = 'downstream'; %#ok<AGROW>
510:         oIp(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_down_A(i) * Mtrx.ct_down(i); %#ok<AGROW>
511:         oIk(end + 1) = oIp(end) / 1000; %#ok<AGROW>
512:         oCt(end + 1) = Mtrx.ct_down(i); %#ok<AGROW>
513:         oIs(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_down_A(i); %#ok<AGROW>
514:         oI0(end + 1) = i0; %#ok<AGROW>
515:         oSrc{end + 1} = src; %#ok<AGROW>
516:         oProv{end + 1} = PROV; oScope{end + 1} = 'PRIMARY'; %#ok<AGROW>
517:     end
518:     if isfinite(Mtrx.I_up_A(i)) && isfinite(Mtrx.ct_up(i))
519:         oLoc{end + 1} = ml{i}; oTyp{end + 1} = mt{i}; oCase{end + 1} = mc{i}; %#ok<AGROW>
520:         oDev{end + 1} = Mtrx.upstream{i}; oSide{end + 1} = 'upstream'; %#ok<AGROW>
521:         oIp(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_up_A(i) * Mtrx.ct_up(i); %#ok<AGROW>
522:         oIk(end + 1) = oIp(end) / 1000; %#ok<AGROW>
523:         oCt(end + 1) = Mtrx.ct_up(i); %#ok<AGROW>
524:         oIs(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_up_A(i); %#ok<AGROW>
525:         oI0(end + 1) = i0; %#ok<AGROW>
526:         oSrc{end + 1} = src; %#ok<AGROW>
527:         oProv{end + 1} = PROV; oScope{end + 1} = 'PRIMARY'; %#ok<AGROW>
528:     end
529: end
530: Trc = table(oLoc', oTyp', oCase', oDev', oSide', oIp', oIk', oCt', ...
531:     oIs', oI0', oSrc', oProv', oScope', ...
532:     'VariableNames', {'fault_location', 'fault_type', 'caseID', ...
533:     'device_id', 'side', 'I_primary_A', 'I_primary_kA', 'CT_ratio', ...
534:     'I_secondary_A', 'I0_A', 'I0_source', 'provenance', 'scope'});
535: if height(Trc) < 1
536:     error('phase5b_production:rows', 'relay-currents table empty (matrix sides all missing).');
537: end
538: end

581: function S = sensitivity_v2(T40, devicesProd, Rreg)
582: %SENSITIVITY_V2  v2-adapted GEN-scope sensitivity (C11 BLOCKED fallback).
583: %   The frozen PHASE5_SENSITIVITY is BLOCKED for v2 reuse (never modified):
584: %   it hard-codes the v1 2000 CT on its upstream GSUT leg
585: %   (phase5_sensitivity.m:137 'IsUp = pkUp / 2000', :190 'primUp / 2000',
586: %   :193 reason 'upstream-GSUT-HV-51-2000/1-untouched', comments :9/:11)
587: %   instead of reading device ct_ratio (1600 in v2). Evidence pinned in
588: %   test_phase5b_writer. This engine ports the frozen GEN-scope doctrine
589: %   exactly, reading every pickup/CT/TMS from the v2-resolved devices:
590: %     GEN-51 (phase, all 40 combos) + GEN-51N (earth, LG/LLG only, 20 rows)
591: %     = 60 rows; GEN dial fixed from the PRIMARY scheme via the device CT
592: %     (Is_fixed = P/ct_device, 15000); legacy secondaries via Rreg.ct_legacy
593: %     (16000 fence, read never hard-coded); upstream GSUT-HV-51 backup via
594: %     ITS device CT (1600 — the fix) with the v2-resolved pickup/TMS;
595: %     EF TMS 0.15 from the stamped devices (pickup-resolved, never registry
596: %     0.20). Frozen phase5_ct + phase5_time + phase5_ct_table(T40,16000)
597: %     audit reference only (legacy fence unchanged in v2).
598: %   Relay primaries mirror frozen branch parity: GEN-51 phase -> GEN_Q leg
599: %   else net total; GEN-51N F1/F2 -> 3xI0 neutral-once else LG-exact If/3
600: %   else NaN; GEN-51N F3/F4/F5 -> 3x leg_NER_earth delta block else NaN.
601: %   Verdict doctrine identical to frozen (CTI 0.3 s; NO-TRIP / NO-PAIR /
602: %   NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA). 28 locked cols, scope
603: %   SENSITIVITY, provenance LEGACY-tagged + v2-adaptation note.
604: d51 = finddev(devicesProd, 'GEN-51');
605: d51N = finddev(devicesProd, 'GEN-51N');
606: dUp = finddev(devicesProd, 'GSUT-HV-51');
607: ctGen = read_ct(d51, 'GEN-51');
608: ctLeg = double(Rreg.ct_legacy);
609: if ~(isscalar(ctLeg) && isfinite(ctLeg) && ctLeg > 0)
610:     error('phase5b_production:sensitivity', 'Rreg.ct_legacy must be finite > 0 (16000 fence, read never hard-coded).');
611: end
612: ctUp = read_ct(dUp, 'GSUT-HV-51');
613: pk51 = read_pickup(d51, 'GEN-51');
614: pkN = read_pickup(d51N, 'GEN-51N');
615: pkUp = read_pickup(dUp, 'GSUT-HV-51');
616: [tms51, cv51] = read_tc(d51, 'GEN-51');
617: [tmsN, cvN] = read_tc(d51N, 'GEN-51N');
618: [tmsUp, cvUp] = read_tc(dUp, 'GSUT-HV-51');
619: IsFix51 = pk51 / ctGen;
620: IsFixN = pkN / ctGen;
621: IsUp = pkUp / ctUp;
622: CTI = 0.3;
623: locs = tocell(T40.fault_location);
624: typs = tocell(T40.fault_type);
625: cases = tocell(T40.caseID);
626: n = height(T40);
627: If_A = double(T40.I_primary_A(:));
628: If_kA = double(T40.I_primary_kA(:));
629: if any(~isfinite(If_A)) || any(~isfinite(If_kA))
630:     error('phase5b_production:sensitivity', 'T40 fault currents must be finite.');
631: end
632: hasIseq0 = any(strcmp(T40.Properties.VariableNames, 'Iseq0_kA'));
633: if hasIseq0
634:     Iseq0_kA = double(T40.Iseq0_kA(:));
635: else
636:     Iseq0_kA = NaN(n, 1);
637: end

function [NP, NF] = run_phase5b_tests(varargin)
%RUN_PHASE5B_TESTS  Phase-5b test runner (Phase-5b Task C12).
%   [NP, NF] = RUN_PHASE5B_TESTS() runs every matlab/tests/test_phase5b_*.m
%   suite (discovered via the test_phase5b_ledger anchor on the path, so gap
%   suites are picked up without runner edits) plus the 14-leg
%   phase5b_validate() engine (R0 Phase-4 regression + B01..B13), accumulates
%   passed/failed counts (each validation leg counts one check), and prints
%   'phase5b_tests: NP passed, NF failed'.
%   A suite that errors counts one failure and the runner continues, so one
%   broken suite never hides the rest; the error text stays loud.
%   The frozen v1 runner is never called or modified (see plan global
%   constraints).
%   All errors raised here are 'phase5b'-prefixed.
if nargin ~= 0
    error('phase5b_tests:args', 'usage: [NP, NF] = run_phase5b_tests().');
end
anchor = which('test_phase5b_ledger');
if isempty(anchor)
    error('phase5b_tests:path', 'test_phase5b_ledger not on path (run with addpath(genpath(''matlab''))).');
end

1: function R = run_phase5_production(tag, varargin)
2: %RUN_PHASE5_PRODUCTION  End-to-end Phase-5 production driver (Task 17/T20).
3: %   R = RUN_PHASE5_PRODUCTION(tag) builds every Phase-5 protection output
4: %   from the frozen Phase-4 production archive (read-only) and writes
5: %   results/phase5_protection/ via PHASE5_WRITER:
6: %     9 CSVs (device_registry, relay_settings, fault_inputs,
7: %     relay_currents, coordination_matrix, coordination_margins,
8: %     breaker_duty, sensitivity, validation) + manifest.json + run_log.txt
9: %     + sha256.txt, plus TCC plots via PHASE5_TCC into plots/.
10: %
11: %   R = RUN_PHASE5_PRODUCTION(tag, 'overwrite', true) re-runs into the
12: %   existing results/phase5_protection directory. Without the flag, an
13: %   existing directory errors error('phase5_production:exists').
14: %   Default tag 'production' (manifest tag only; the output directory is
15: %   fixed results/phase5_protection).
16: %
17: %   Binding carry-forwards (locked, read ALL consumers first):
18: %   (a) Relay settings/pickups use the T6 PRODUCTION path: GIS-Q0-51 =
19: %       1.2 x FL_anchor read live from phase4_ct_data.csv FL_anchor_kA
20: %       (LINE_Q9 path; ~1043.95 A), never the 2400 A rated-proxy fallback
21: %       that phase5_coord/phase5_tcc use internally when the registry
22: %       carries NaN pickup. Production pickups are stamped into a devices
23: %       copy (registry never edited) so phase5_coord grades production
24: %       settings (T6-registry source). TCC footers keep their disclosed
25: %       fallback; production CSVs carry production values.
26: %   (b) Iseq0_kA is joined live from phase4_fault_currents.csv
27: %       (backbone-first dedup identical to phase5_import) into the import
28: %       table before phase5_coord, and into relay-currents/earth rows, so
29: %       LLG earth uses real I0; the I0-NOT-DETERMINABLE path only fires
30: %       where production truly lacks I0.
31: %   (c) r_kappa_ip (borrowed-shape peak, informational only) is joined the
32: %       same way and passes through phase5_duty into I_peak_kA; missing ->
33: %       NaN + MISSING-peak note, never invented.
34: %   (d) Task-15 full close: phase5_writer errors on any empty
35: %       provenance/scope (phase5_writer:provenance).
36: %   (e) TCC plots regenerate via phase5_tcc into
37: %       results/phase5_protection/plots/ as part of this run
38: %       (deterministic overwrite within the new dir only).
39: %   (f) manifest.json carries tag, timestamp, the INPUT production
40: %       manifest SHA-256 (production manifest.json hashed read-only plus
41: %       the production sha256.txt lines transcribed), code SHA-256 of
42: %       every matlab/phase5/*.m, row counts, and the live phase5_validate
43: %       reference. sha256.txt covers the 9 CSVs + manifest + run_log +
44: %       validation CSV (11 lines). run_log.txt carries settings + row
45: %       counts + validation/test counts. Existing modules are consumed
46: %       with their exact call signatures and never modified.
47: %
48: %   Validation/tests: live phase5_validate() supplies the validation CSV
49: %   and manifest reference; run_phase5_tests() runs after the tables and
50: %   TCC plots but BEFORE phase5_writer, so NP/NF land in run_log.txt
51: %   before sha256.txt is hashed (never appended after hashing). Counts
52: %   are recorded honestly, never gated-to-pass here (the T19 gate judges).
53: %   All errors are 'phase5'-prefixed.
54: t0run = tic;
55: if nargin < 1 || isempty(tag)
56:     tag = 'production';
57: end
58: if isstring(tag) && isscalar(tag), tag = char(tag); end
59: if ~(ischar(tag) && isrow(tag) && ~isempty(tag))
60:     error('phase5_production:badTag', 'tag must be a non-empty char rowvec (manifest tag).');
61: end
62: overwrite = false;
63: for k = 1:2:numel(varargin)
64:     nm = varargin{k};
65:     if isstring(nm), nm = char(nm); end
66:     if k + 1 > numel(varargin)
67:         error('phase5_production:args', 'Name-value options need a value.');
68:     end
69:     vv = varargin{k + 1};
70:     switch lower(nm)
71:         case 'overwrite'
72:             overwrite = logical(vv);
73:         otherwise
74:             error('phase5_production:args', 'Unknown option ''%s''.', nm);
75:     end
76: end
77: root = ashuganj_root();
78: outDir = fullfile(root, 'results', 'phase5_protection');
79: if exist(outDir, 'dir') == 7 && ~overwrite
80:     error('phase5_production:exists', ...
81:         'Output directory %s exists; re-run with ''overwrite'', true.', outDir);
82: end
83: % ---- (f) INPUT production manifest SHA, read-only ----
84: prodMan = fullfile(root, 'results', 'phase4_fault', 'production', 'manifest.json');
85: prodSha = fullfile(root, 'results', 'phase4_fault', 'production', 'sha256.txt');
86: if exist(prodMan, 'file') ~= 2
87:     error('phase5_production:input', 'production manifest missing (read-only input): %s', prodMan);
88: end
89: if exist(prodSha, 'file') ~= 2
90:     error('phase5_production:input', 'production sha256.txt missing (read-only input): %s', prodSha);
91: end
92: inputManifestSha = sha256file(prodMan);
93: inputShaLines = strsplit(strtrim(fileread(prodSha)), '\n');
94: inputShaLines = inputShaLines(:)';
95: % ---- Registry + backbone import (40 rows, 2x5x4 Ikpp) ----
96: Rreg = phase5_registry();
97: Ti = phase5_import(root);
98: if height(Ti) ~= 40
99:     error('phase5_production:matrix', 'phase5_import backbone row count %d ~= 40.', height(Ti));
100: end
101: % ---- (b)+(c) Iseq0_kA + r_kappa_ip joins from production currents ----
102: TiJ = join_production_peaks(root, Ti);
103: % ---- (a) FL anchors live from production ct_data (frozen flows) ----
104: anchors = read_anchors(root);
105: % Imin anchors, coord-consistent (totals-based; branch legs affect times only).
106: [IminPhase, IminEarth] = pickup_anchors(TiJ);
107: % ---- (a) T6 PRODUCTION pickups, stamped into a devices copy ----
108: [devicesProd, setRows, settingsLines] = production_settings(Rreg, anchors, IminPhase, IminEarth);
109: % ---- Tables 1-3: registry / settings / fault_inputs ----
110: Tregistry = registry_table(Rreg);
111: TfaultInputs = table(Ti.fault_location, Ti.fault_type, Ti.caseID, Ti.m, ...
112:     Ti.stage, Ti.I_primary_kA, Ti.I_primary_A, Ti.provenance, ...
113:     repmat({'PRIMARY'}, height(Ti), 1), ...
114:     'VariableNames', {'fault_location', 'fault_type', 'caseID', 'm', ...
115:     'stage', 'I_primary_kA', 'I_primary_A', 'provenance', 'scope'});
116: % ---- Coordination on production settings + joined Iseq0 ----
117: [Mtrx, Mrg] = phase5_coord(devicesProd, TiJ);
118: Mtrx.provenance = repmat({['DERIVED:phase5_coord-branch-through-current-' ...
119:     'margin-CTI-0.3s-study-threshold-SOURCE-BACKED-Phase-4-import']}, height(Mtrx), 1);
120: Mtrx.scope = repmat({'PRIMARY'}, height(Mtrx), 1);
121: Mrg.provenance = repmat({['DERIVED:phase5_coord-margin-dt-t_up-minus-t_down-' ...
122:     'SOURCE-BACKED-Phase-4-import']}, height(Mrg), 1);
123: Mrg.scope = repmat({'PRIMARY'}, height(Mrg), 1);
124: % ---- Relay currents traced from the graded matrix sides ----
125: TrelayCurrents = relay_currents_table(Mtrx, TiJ);
126: % ---- Breaker duty on breaker-path through-currents + peak passthrough ----
127: Dduty = phase5_duty(TiJ, []);
128: Dprov = repmat({'SOURCE-BACKED:Phase-4-production-import-through-current-branch'}, height(Dduty), 1);
129: isNote = strcmp(tocell(Dduty.verdict), 'NOTE');
130: Dprov(isNote) = {'ESTIMATED:50.00-kA-station-reference-informational-only-never-duty-basis'};
131: Dduty.provenance = Dprov;
132: Dduty.scope = repmat({'PRIMARY'}, height(Dduty), 1);
133: % ---- Fenced sensitivity (production-stamped devices; GEN outputs identical) ----
134: Tsens = phase5_sensitivity(TiJ, devicesProd);
135: % ---- Live validation -> validation CSV + manifest reference ----
136: V = phase5_validate();
137: vPass = sum([V.legs.pass]); vTotal = numel(V.legs);
138: vIds = strjoin({V.legs.id}, ',');
139: vNote = sprintf('live phase5_validate %d/%d legs pass (%s)', vPass, vTotal, vIds);
140: Tvalid = table({V.legs.id}', double([V.legs.pass]'), [V.legs.residual]', ...
141:     {V.legs.note}', ...
142:     repmat({'DERIVED:phase5_validate-live-run-R0-V1-V15'}, vTotal, 1), ...
143:     repmat({'PRIMARY'}, vTotal, 1), ...
144:     'VariableNames', {'leg', 'pass', 'residual', 'note', 'provenance', 'scope'});
145: % ---- (e) TCC plots regenerate into the new plots dir ----
146: plotDir = fullfile(outDir, 'plots');
147: Stcc = phase5_tcc(plotDir, root);
148: settingsLines{end + 1} = sprintf('TCC plots regenerated via phase5_tcc: %s, %s', ... %#ok<AGROW>
149:     Stcc.gen_png, Stcc.grid_png);
150: % ---- Tests run BEFORE the writer so counts land in run_log pre-hash ----
151: [NP, NF] = run_phase5_tests();
152: % ---- Writer (d: provenance full close enforced inside) ----
153: tables = struct('registry', Tregistry, 'settings', setRows, ...
154:     'faultInputs', TfaultInputs, 'relayCurrents', TrelayCurrents, ...
155:     'coordMatrix', Mtrx, 'coordMargins', Mrg, 'duty', Dduty, ...
156:     'sensitivity', Tsens, 'validation', Tvalid);
157: meta = struct('tag', tag, 'inputManifestSha', inputManifestSha, ...
158:     'inputShaLines', {inputShaLines}, ...
159:     'validation', struct('pass', vPass, 'total', vTotal, 'note', vNote), ...
160:     'testCounts', struct('NP', NP, 'NF', NF), ...
161:     'settingsLines', {settingsLines}, ...
162:     'extraNotes', {{'TCC plots (tcc_gen.png, tcc_grid.png) in plots/ are study-curve figures, not hashed in sha256.txt.'}});
163: W = phase5_writer(outDir, tables, meta);
164: secs = toc(t0run);
165: fprintf(['run_phase5_production %s: registry=%d settings=%d inputs=%d currents=%d ' ...
166:     'matrix=%d margins=%d duty=%d sens=%d valid=%d/%d tests NP=%d NF=%d in %s (%.1f s)\n'], ...
167:     tag, height(Tregistry), height(setRows), height(TfaultInputs), ...
168:     height(TrelayCurrents), height(Mtrx), height(Mrg), height(Dduty), ...
169:     height(Tsens), vPass, vTotal, NP, NF, outDir, secs);
170: R = struct('dir', outDir, 'tag', tag, 'rowCounts', W.rowCounts, ...
171:     'validatePass', vPass, 'validateTotal', vTotal, 'NP', NP, 'NF', NF, ...
172:     'genPng', Stcc.gen_png, 'gridPng', Stcc.grid_png, 'secs', secs);
173: end

175: function TiJ = join_production_peaks(root, Ti)
176: %JOIN_PRODUCTION_PEAKS  (b)+(c): Iseq0_kA + r_kappa_ip from currents CSV.
177: %   Backbone-first dedup identical to phase5_import (filter stage Ikpp +
178: %   m 0.5, first-per-(caseID,location,fault_type) in file order), then an
179: %   inner join on those keys. Every import row must hit, else
180: %   phase5_production:join (never silently NaN-filled).
181: Fp = fullfile(root, 'results', 'phase4_fault', 'production', 'phase4_fault_currents.csv');
182: C = readtable(Fp);
183: for k = 1:numel({'fault_type', 'location', 'm', 'caseID', 'stage', 'Iseq0_kA', 'r_kappa_ip'})
184:     need = {'fault_type', 'location', 'm', 'caseID', 'stage', 'Iseq0_kA', 'r_kappa_ip'};
185:     if ~any(strcmp(C.Properties.VariableNames, need{k}))
186:         error('phase5_production:schema', 'production currents CSV missing column %s.', need{k});
187:     end
188: end
189: Cb = C(strcmp(C.stage, 'Ikpp') & C.m == 0.5, :);
190: keys = strcat(Cb.caseID, '|', Cb.location, '|', Cb.fault_type);
191: [~, ia] = unique(keys, 'stable');
192: Cb = Cb(ia, :);
193: n = height(Ti);
194: Iseq0 = NaN(n, 1); rkp = NaN(n, 1);
195: tloc = tocell(Ti.fault_location); ttyp = tocell(Ti.fault_type); tcs = tocell(Ti.caseID);
196: bloc = tocell(Cb.location); btyp = tocell(Cb.fault_type); bcs = tocell(Cb.caseID);
197: for i = 1:n
198:     hit = find(strcmp(bcs, tcs{i}) & strcmp(bloc, tloc{i}) & strcmp(btyp, ttyp{i}), 1, 'first');
199:     if isempty(hit)
200:         error('phase5_production:join', ...
201:             'production currents join missed %s %s %s (backbone keys diverged).', ...
202:             tcs{i}, tloc{i}, ttyp{i});
203:     end
204:     Iseq0(i) = Cb.Iseq0_kA(hit);
205:     rkp(i) = Cb.r_kappa_ip(hit);
206: end
207: if any(~isfinite(Iseq0)) || any(~isfinite(rkp))
208:     error('phase5_production:join', 'joined Iseq0_kA/r_kappa_ip must be finite on all 40 backbone rows.');
209: end
210: TiJ = Ti;
211: TiJ.Iseq0_kA = Iseq0;
212: TiJ.r_kappa_ip = rkp;
213: end

215: function anchors = read_anchors(root)
216: %READ_ANCHORS  Frozen-flow FL_anchor_kA per through_path, live from ct_data.
217: G = readtable(fullfile(root, 'results', 'phase4_fault', 'production', 'phase4_ct_data.csv'));
218: if ~all(ismember({'through_path', 'FL_anchor_kA'}, G.Properties.VariableNames))
219:     error('phase5_production:schema', 'production ct_data CSV missing through_path/FL_anchor_kA.');
220: end
221: paths = {'GEN_Q', 'GSUT_HV', 'GRID_Q', 'LINE_Q9'};
222: anchors = struct();
223: tp = tocell(G.through_path);
224: for k = 1:numel(paths)
225:     u = unique(G.FL_anchor_kA(strcmp(tp, paths{k})));
226:     u = u(isfinite(u));
227:     if numel(u) ~= 1
228:         error('phase5_production:anchor', ...
229:             'through_path %s must carry exactly one FL_anchor_kA (got %d).', paths{k}, numel(u));
230:     end
231:     anchors.(paths{k}) = u;
232: end
233: end

235: function [IminPhase, IminEarth] = pickup_anchors(TiJ)
236: %PICKUP_ANCHORS  Must-detect anchors for the T6 production pickup calls.
237: %   IminPhase: coord-consistent min over phase-fault totals (LLL/LL/LLG,
238: %   never LG earth). IminEarth: LG-only min over LG totals. The LG-only
239: %   restriction is the phase5_pickup contract ('EF uses F1 LG 7.27 A') and
240: %   matches validate V2/V9 legs plus the T6 methodology (GEN-51N 5 A
241: %   must-detect F1 LG with margin ~1.45). The LLG-inclusive 3I0 min that
242: %   phase5_coord uses INTERNALLY (LLG 3I0 ~3.63 A < 5 A pickup) stays
243: %   where it belongs: honest below-pickup NO-TRIP rows in the
244: %   coordination matrix, never in the settings must-detect anchor.
245: typs = tocell(TiJ.fault_type);
246: ph = strcmp(typs, 'LLL') | strcmp(typs, 'LL') | strcmp(typs, 'LLG');
247: IfA = double(TiJ.I_primary_A(:));
248: if any(ph)
249:     IminPhase = min(IfA(ph));
250: else
251:     IminPhase = min(IfA);
252: end
253: lg = strcmp(typs, 'LG');
254: if any(lg)
255:     IminEarth = min(IfA(lg));
256: else
257:     IminEarth = 7.27200442799167;
258: end
259: end

261: function [devicesProd, setRows, settingsLines] = production_settings(Rreg, anchors, IminPhase, IminEarth)
262: %PRODUCTION_SETTINGS  (a): T6 PRODUCTION pickups stamped on a devices copy.
263: devs = Rreg.devices;
264: ids = {devs.device_id};
265: d51 = devs(strcmp(ids, 'GEN-51'));
266: d51N = devs(strcmp(ids, 'GEN-51N'));
267: dHV = devs(strcmp(ids, 'GSUT-HV-51'));
268: dQ0 = devs(strcmp(ids, 'GIS-Q0-51'));
269: % GEN-51: 1.25 x rated (12019 A -> 15023.75 A), no-trip-on-load vs rated.
270: P51 = phase5_pickup(d51, double(Rreg.gen.Irated_A), IminPhase);
271: if abs(P51.setting - 15023.75) > 1e-9
272:     error('phase5_production:pickup', 'GEN-51 production pickup %.4f A ~= 15023.75 A.', P51.setting);
273: end
274: % GEN-51N: 5 A SENSITIVE study setting, must-detect F1 LG.
275: PN = phase5_pickup(d51N, 0, IminEarth);
276: if abs(PN.setting - 5) > 1e-12
277:     error('phase5_production:pickup', 'GEN-51N production pickup %.6f A ~= 5 A.', PN.setting);
278: end
279: % GSUT-HV-51: generic 1.2 x max(rated, frozen-flow anchor).
280: hvAnchor = anchors.GSUT_HV * 1000;
281: PHV = phase5_pickup(dHV, hvAnchor, IminPhase);
282: % GIS-Q0-51 PRODUCTION PATH: 1.2 x LINE_Q9 FL_anchor (never rated-proxy).
283: q0Anchor = anchors.LINE_Q9 * 1000;
284: PQ0 = phase5_pickup(dQ0, q0Anchor, IminPhase);
285: if abs(PQ0.setting / q0Anchor - 1.2) > 1e-12
286:     error('phase5_production:pickup', 'GIS-Q0-51 production pickup must be 1.2x FL_anchor.');
287: end
288: if abs(PQ0.setting - 1.2 * 869.956651959241) > 1e-6
289:     error('phase5_production:pickup', ...
290:         'GIS-Q0-51 production pickup %.4f A drifts from 1.2x frozen LINE_Q9 anchor 1043.95 A.', PQ0.setting);
291: end
292: % Stamp into a copy (registry struct itself never edited).
293: devicesProd = devs;
294: devicesProd(strcmp(ids, 'GEN-51')).pickup_A = P51.setting;
295: devicesProd(strcmp(ids, 'GEN-51N')).pickup_A = PN.setting;
296: devicesProd(strcmp(ids, 'GSUT-HV-51')).pickup_A = PHV.setting;
297: devicesProd(strcmp(ids, 'GIS-Q0-51')).pickup_A = PQ0.setting;
298: % Applied TMS/curve mirror the coord study defaults (registry NaN/empty).
299: setRows = settings_table(devs, P51, PN, PHV, PQ0);
300: settingsLines = {
301:     sprintf('GEN-51 phase pickup %.2f A-primary (1.25x rated 12019 A; %s)', P51.setting, P51.basis)
302:     sprintf('GEN-51N earth pickup %.2f A-primary (SENSITIVE; %s)', PN.setting, PN.basis)
303:     sprintf('GSUT-HV-51 phase pickup %.2f A-primary (1.2x max(rated 1150 A, GSUT_HV anchor %.4f A); %s)', PHV.setting, hvAnchor, PHV.source)
304:     sprintf('GIS-Q0-51 phase pickup %.4f A-primary (PRODUCTION 1.2x LINE_Q9 FL_anchor %.6f A from phase4_ct_data.csv; never 2400 A rated-proxy)', PQ0.setting, q0Anchor)
305:     sprintf('FL anchors (phase4_ct_data.csv FL_anchor_kA, frozen flows): GEN_Q %.4f, GSUT_HV %.5f, GRID_Q %.5f, LINE_Q9 %.6f kA', anchors.GEN_Q, anchors.GSUT_HV, anchors.GRID_Q, anchors.LINE_Q9)
306:     sprintf('Imin anchors: phase %.2f A (LLL/LL/LLG totals min); earth %.5f A (LG totals min per T6 EF contract; LLG 3I0 below-pickup outcomes live honestly in the matrix)', IminPhase, IminEarth)
307:     'TMS study defaults (ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION, registry NaN): GEN 0.1 / GSUT 0.2 / GIS 0.3; curve SI (STUDY constants, never manufacturer)'
308:     'CTI 0.3 s (ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION study threshold); primary CT 15000/1 SOURCE-BACKED, 16000/1 LEGACY fenced sensitivity only'
309:     'Breaker duty: Q0 (52-1) only; Q1/Q2/Q9 disconnectors never duty; peak r_kappa_ip borrowed-shape informational only, never duty input'
310:     'CSV dialect: RFC-4180 comma-separated; text fields with commas are double-quoted (notably the GSUT-HV-51 basis cell). MATLAB readers must use readtable(fp,''Delimiter'','','') because the auto-delimiter sniffer misparses quoted-comma rows.'
311:     };
312: end

314: function setRows = settings_table(devs, P51, PN, PHV, PQ0)
315: %SETTINGS_TABLE  7-row relay_settings CSV (4 production + 3 MISSING).
316: ctOf = @(id) devs(strcmp({devs.device_id}, id)).ct_ratio;
317: [t51, c51] = tc_default(devs(strcmp({devs.device_id}, 'GEN-51')), 'GEN-51', 0.1);
318: [tN, cN] = tc_default(devs(strcmp({devs.device_id}, 'GEN-51N')), 'GEN-51N', 0.1);
319: [tHV, cHV] = tc_default(devs(strcmp({devs.device_id}, 'GSUT-HV-51')), 'GSUT-HV-51', 0.2);
320: [tQ0, cQ0] = tc_default(devs(strcmp({devs.device_id}, 'GIS-Q0-51')), 'GIS-Q0-51', 0.3);
321: dids = {'GEN-51'; 'GEN-51N'; 'GSUT-HV-51'; 'GIS-Q0-51'; ...
322:     'GIS-Q0-50'; 'LINE-21-note'; 'REMOTE-GRID-boundary'};
323: sets = [P51.setting; PN.setting; PHV.setting; PQ0.setting; NaN; NaN; NaN];
324: units = {'A-primary'; 'A-primary'; 'A-primary'; 'A-primary'; ''; ''; ''};
325: basis = {P51.basis; PN.basis; PHV.basis; PQ0.basis; ...
326:     'NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA:GIS-Q0-50-high-set-DISABLED-unless-justified'; ...
327:     'NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA:distance-settings-no-source'; ...
328:     'NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA:remote-grid-monitoring-only-no-device'};
329: src = {P51.source; PN.source; PHV.source; PQ0.source; ...
330:     'MISSING:no-high-set-source'; 'MISSING:no-distance-source'; 'MISSING:no-device'};
331: val = {[P51.validation ';tms-study-default-0.1;curve-SI-STUDY']; ...
332:     [PN.validation ';tms-study-default-0.1;curve-SI-STUDY']; ...
333:     [PHV.validation ';tms-study-default-0.2;curve-SI-STUDY']; ...
334:     [PQ0.validation ';tms-study-default-0.3;curve-SI-STUDY']; ...
335:     'DISABLED-unless-justified;no high-set invented'; ...
336:     'NOTE-only;no settings invented'; ...

467: function hex = sha256file(path)
468: %SHA256FILE  SHA-256 hex digest via Java MessageDigest (no toolbox).
469: md = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance('SHA-256');
470: jpath = java.io.File(path).toPath();

472: dig = md.digest();
473: bi = java.math.BigInteger(1, dig);
474: hex = char(bi.toString(16));
475: hex = [repmat('0', 1, 64 - numel(hex)) hex];

function assert_whitelist(T, tname)
%ASSERT_WHITELIST  Provenance class whitelist (error otherwise).
%   Legal classes: SOURCE-BACKED / DERIVED / ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION /
%   CONDITIONAL / CONDITIONAL_ASSUMPTION / SENSITIVITY / LEGACY / MISSING /

%   (C3 concern resolved: yes). Master correction 2026-09-19 adds
%   CONDITIONAL(+_ASSUMPTION)/SENSITIVITY/NOT_DETERMINABLE prefixes.
legal = {'SOURCE-BACKED', 'DERIVED', 'ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION', ...

    'NOT_DETERMINABLE', 'NOT-DETERMINABLE', ...
    'LEGACY', 'MISSING', 'USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC'};

> simulated. Coordination shortfalls are "study-setting coordination shortfalls," never verdicts about installed
> equipment. TCCs are split into PHYSICAL/SOURCE-BACKED vs GENERIC STUDY classes. All relay data are **study

> (informational only, never a breaker-duty input).

---

## 1. Executive summary

Phase-5b applies a physical protection architecture plus a qualified backup-OC/EF coordination study to the
frozen Phase-4 production fault package for Ashuganj South, covering 2 cases (`LF360_GAT_OUT`,
`LF360_GAT_IN`) x 5 fault locations (F1–F5) x 4 fault types (LLL/LG/LL/LLG) = 40 backbone rows.

Headline v2 results (each reproduced from the shipped `results/phase5_protection_v2/` CSVs, read with
`readtable(fp, 'Delimiter', ',')`):

- Study pickups (v2, as found): GEN-51-SI **17170.8 A** primary (1.20xImax 14309 A), GEN-51N-SI-STUDY **5 A**
  primary (SENSITIVE retained case), GSUT-HV-51 **1380 A** primary via 1600/1, GIS-Q0-51 **1043.94798235109 A**
  primary via 1600/1 (`phase5_relay_settings.csv`, 8 rows). Separate PHYSICAL baseline GEN-51-SIEMENS-BL
  **17171 A** primary (1.1447 A secondary via 15000/1, DT-??, tdef 3.00 s ?? PENDING-COORDINATION,
  USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC, inverse prohibited — never dispatched to `phase5_time`).
- Coordination matrix v2 (96 rows, as found): **FAIL = 20, NO-TRIP = 28, NO-PAIR = 24,
  NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA = 24, PASS = 0 (production-v2, 96 rows)**. Identical counts appear in
  `phase5_coordination_margins.csv`. No margin was tuned; shortfalls are study-setting coordination shortfalls
  reported honestly (see Sections 9 and 17).
- Breaker duty v2 (81 rows, as found): **40 x Q0 NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA + 40 x 52G PASS +
  1 x Q0 NOTE**. That is 40 Q0 rows with no interrupting rating sourced, 40 52G rows PASS vs the sourced
  52G/GCB-10BAC10 100 kA sym breaking rating, plus one informational NOTE (F3 LLL 50.530885 kA +1.06% vs the
  estimated 50 kA station reference). Equipment withstand (GIS 50 kA) lives only in equipment columns, never as
  an interrupting rating.
- Effectiveness v2 (`phase5b_effectiveness.csv`, 48 rows = 40 backbone + 8 Siemens-baseline F1 duplicates, as
  found): **ASSERTABLE-DETECT = 24, NOT-DETERMINABLE = 24**. F1/F2 primaries assertable (87G/87T); F3/F4/F5
  primaries NOT-DETERMINABLE (87B/7SD settings missing; F5 out-of-zone). Primary timing 0.045 s derived
  fast-main clearing applies only to F1/87G + 52G identified; all other primary times NaN with reasons (see
  Section 16).
- Low-earth-fault physics preserved: F1 LG **7.272 A** primary -> **0.4848 mA** secondary through
  15000/1, covered by the 5 A sensitive EF study pickup with margin **1.454**; branch-through-current
  F1 LG GEN_Q **8.4141 kA** pinned by audit (never a bus total).
- Sensitivity (60 rows, all scope SENSITIVITY): 16000/1 recomputation fenced to generator-CT scope only.
  Validation **16/16** frozen-framework legs; suite **355 passed / 0 failed** at the v2 stamp (v1 suite 344/0 is
  frozen in the §20 v1 appendix).

1: function T = ashuganj_transformers()
2: %ASHUGANJ_TRANSFORMERS  Transformer database - Ashuganj 450 MW CCPP SOUTH.
3: %
4: %   T = ASHUGANJ_TRANSFORMERS() returns a struct array with one element per
5: %   power transformer, populated for the Specialized Power Systems
6: %   "Three-Phase Transformer (Two Windings)" block in PER-UNIT units.
7: %
8: %   Three transformers exist in the South plant:
9: %       GSUT 10BAT10   230/22   kV   355/460/515 MVA  ONAN/ODAN/ODAF  YNd1
10: %       UAT  10BBT10    22/6.9  kV    19/25     MVA  ONAN/ONAF       Dyn11
11: %       GAT  10BBT20   230/6.9/3.32 kV  19/25   MVA  ONAN/ONAF       YNyn0+d11
12: %
13: %   The GAT was ABSENT from the prior CYME PSAF model (defect D6).  Its
14: %   presence closes a loop: 230 kV -> GSUT -> 22 kV -> UAT -> 6.6 kV -> GAT ->
15: %   230 kV.  Approved answer Q4c keeps BOTH states (GAT in / GAT out) as
16: %   separate load-flow cases so the loop effect can be reported.
17: %
18: %   -------- Impedance convention -------------------------------------
19: %   Nameplates give the magnitude Z (%) and the resistance R (%) at a stated
20: %   MVA base.  The reactance is therefore DERIVED, not read:
21: %       X = sqrt(Z^2 - R^2)                                   [pu]
22: %   and is split equally between the two windings, R1 = R2 = R/2 and
23: %   L1 = L2 = X/2, because the nameplate gives only the total leakage
24: %   impedance and no winding-by-winding split exists in the source set.
25: %   The equal split is a REPRESENTATION CHOICE, not a claimed measurement;
26: %   in a two-winding load flow only the series total R + jX affects the
27: %   result, so the split has no numerical consequence at all.
28: %
29: %   -------- Magnetising branch ---------------------------------------
30: %   BOTH magnetising elements are now DERIVED from documented data.
31: %
32: %   Rm from the documented no-load LOSS:
33: %       Rm(pu) = S_rated / P_no-load
34: %   Lm from the documented no-load CURRENT, by removing the loss
35: %   component that Rm already carries:
36: %       (1/Lm)^2 = I0^2 - (1/Rm)^2        =>  Lm = 1/sqrt(I0^2 - (1/Rm)^2)
37: %   with I0 the datasheet excitation current at 100 % rated voltage, in pu
38: %   of rated current on the same MVA base as Rm and Z.
39: %
40: %   HISTORY - this replaces an earlier treatment that set Lm = 1e6 pu
41: %   (numerically open) on the stated ground that "no-load current is absent
42: %   from every nameplate in the set".  That claim was true of the rating
43: %   PLATES and false of the DATA SHEETS: the GSUT sheet publishes 0.13 %
44: %   and the UAT/GAT sheet publishes ~0.3 % and 0.3 %.  The assumption was
45: %   written before those two documents had been read.  It is retired, not
46: %   tweaked; matlab/data/assumptions/transformer_magnetising_inductance.m
47: %   is kept as a SUPERSEDED record of the error rather than deleted.
48: %
49: %   Effect of the correction, stated as two DIFFERENT quantities so they
50: %   are not confused:
51: %     - magnetising reactive draw now represented, which the open-circuit
52: %       treatment omitted entirely:  0.650 + 0.074 + 0.071 = 0.795 MVAr
53: %       (S_rating/Lm per unit, at 1.0 pu terminal voltage);
54: %     - the resulting shift in the GENERATOR's reactive output is smaller
55: %       than that, because the machine is a PV bus and the 230 kV swing

1: function G = ashuganj_grid()
2: %ASHUGANJ_GRID  External grid equivalent - Ashuganj 450 MW CCPP SOUTH.
3: %
4: %   G = ASHUGANJ_GRID() returns the Thevenin equivalent of the PGCB 230 kV
5: %   network at the plant boundary.
6: %
7: %   ============ READ THIS BEFORE USING ANY NUMBER BELOW ============
8: %   NO VERIFIED PGCB GRID STRENGTH EXISTS IN THE SOURCE SET.
9: %
10: %   The 50 kA figure is the ESTIMATED Siemens external-grid source quantity
11: %   from Generator Data-South §2.4 High voltage network (GRID): UNgrid 230 kV;
12: %   XN 2,66 estimated [= 2.66, European decimal comma]; Sk 19.919 [= 19,919 MVA,
13: %   European decimal]; Ik 50 kA. Line 95 prints XN = UNgrid/(3*IK'') with the
14: %   root symbol lost in extraction; executed math uses √3 giving |Z| =
15: %   2.65581124 ohm. XN ≈ 2.66 is the separately-reported rounded estimate;
16: %   |Z| = 2.65581124 is DERIVED via V^2/Ssc — never pair them as an exact R/X.
17: %   Equipment ratings are documented independently as EQUIPMENT RATINGS
18: %   (GIS 50 kA / 1 s + 3 s short-time withstand, 125 kA peak withstand,
19: %   50 kA making) and are NOT the source of this estimate.
20: %
21: %   Approved answer Q1a: use the impedance implied by that source quantity ONLY
22: %   as an explicitly labelled ESTIMATE, never as verified data.  Every result
23: %   that depends on it must say so.  Its status is therefore ESTIMATED, and it
24: %   is the single weakest number in the whole model.
25: %   =================================================================
26: %
27: %   Phase 3 (Task 4): the equivalent sits at B230_REMOTE behind the locked
28: %   0.7 km physical line L_LINE (B230_1 -> B230_REMOTE). Numerical estimate
29: %   unchanged (ESTIMATED). Q7a history: no 70 km line; pre-Phase-3 the
30: %   equivalent sat at the plant boundary B230_1.
31: %
32: %   See also ASHUGANJ_LINES, ASHUGANJ_MASTER_DATA.
33: 
34: G.Name              = 'EXT_GRID';
35: G.Label             = 'EXT GRID';
36: G.Bus_internal      = 'BGRID230';
37: G.Bus_boundary      = 'B230_1';
38: G.Bus_remote        = 'B230_REMOTE';   % display only: ZGRID spans BGRID230->B230_REMOTE since Phase-3 Task 4; solver wiring uses port handles, not this string
39: G.Grid_equivalent_bus = 'B230_REMOTE'; % display/semantic field (REV3.1 reconciliation): grid-equivalent connection bus; solver uses port handles; Bus_boundary kept for legacy fallback
40: G.Operator          = 'PGCB 230 kV network';
41: 
42: % ---- Voltage -----------------------------------------------------------
43: G.Vnom_V            = 230000;
44: G.Vnom_Status       = 'VERIFIED_ENGINEERING_DOCUMENT';
45: G.Vnom_Source       = 'SLD Rev 03 - 230 kV switchyard nominal voltage';
46: 
47: G.Vset_pu           = 1.00;
48: G.Vset_V            = G.Vset_pu*G.Vnom_V;
49: G.Vset_Status       = 'ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION';
50: G.Vset_Note         = ['The actual PGCB busbar voltage at Ashuganj is NOT ', ...
51:                        'documented. 1.00 pu is used. This is a slack-bus ', ...
52:                        'setpoint, deliberately un-tuned: it is NOT adjusted ', ...
53:                        'to make plant voltages look good, consistent with ', ...
54:                        'approved answer Q8a on tap positions. Every solved ', ...
55:                        'voltage in the model scales essentially linearly ', ...
56:                        'with this figure, so the reader can rescale.'];
57: G.PhaseAngle_deg    = 0;
58: G.PhaseAngle_Status = 'DERIVED_FROM_VERIFIED_DATA';
59: G.PhaseAngle_Note   = 'Angle reference of the whole study, by definition of the slack bus.';
60: 
61: G.f_Hz              = 50;
62: G.f_Status          = 'VERIFIED_PLANT';
63: G.f_Note            = ['50 Hz. The prior CYME PSAF studies in the source set ', ...
64:                        'were built at 60 Hz (defect D2); that frequency is ', ...
65:                        'rejected outright, not averaged or reconciled.'];
66: 
67: % ---- Short-circuit level: the ESTIMATE and its provenance -------------
68: G.Isc_kA            = 50;
69: G.Isc_Status        = 'ESTIMATED';
70: G.Isc_Source        = ['Siemens Generator Data-South §2.4 High voltage network (GRID): ', ...
71:                        'UNgrid 230 kV; XN 2,66 estimated [=2.66]; Sk 19.919 [=19,919 MVA]; ', ...
72:                        'Ik 50 kA. ESTIMATED Siemens external-grid source quantity. ', ...
73:                        'Equipment 50 kA/1 s+3 s, 125 kA peak, 50 kA making are ', ...
74:                        'separate EQUIPMENT RATINGS, not this source.'];
75: G.Isc_Warning       = ['Treating the §2.4 estimated source quantity as a firm fault level ', ...
76:                        'assumes the network is exactly as strong as the Siemens estimate. ', ...
77:                        'That is a source estimate, so this model figure is an ESTIMATE ', ...
78:                        'on grid strength and therefore a LOWER BOUND on ', ...
79:                        'grid impedance. Consequence: the model understates ', ...
80:                        'the boundary voltage deviation caused by plant ', ...
81:                        'export. Direction of the error is known; magnitude ', ...
82:                        'is not.'];
83: 
84: G.Ssc_MVA           = sqrt(3)*G.Vnom_V*G.Isc_kA*1000/1e6;
85: G.Ssc_Status        = 'DERIVED_FROM_VERIFIED_DATA';   % derived FROM AN ESTIMATE
86: G.Ssc_Derivation    = 'S = sqrt(3) * 230 kV * 50 kA';
87: G.Ssc_Note          = ['DERIVED_FROM_VERIFIED_DATA describes the ARITHMETIC ', ...
88:                        'only. The INPUT is ESTIMATED, so the result inherits ', ...
89:                        'ESTIMATED confidence. Do not quote this as verified.'];
90: 
91: % ---- Equivalent impedance ---------------------------------------------
92: G.XR_ratio          = inf;
93: G.XR_Status         = 'ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION';
94: G.XR_Note           = ['Q1a approved: X/R is NOT documented, so no ', ...
95:                        'resistance is invented. R = 0 exactly, giving an ', ...
96:                        'infinite X/R. MEASURED effect (test_grid_sensitivity ', ...
97:                        'Part 2, which corrected an earlier wrong claim here ', ...
98:                        'that the angle shift is "slightly overstated"): the ', ...
99:                        'boundary ANGLE is essentially INVARIANT under X/R ', ...
100:                        '(0.0072 deg spread), because holding |Z| fixed pins ', ...
101:                        'X to within 2 %. What DOES move is the boundary ', ...
102:                        'voltage MAGNITUDE, and upward - R = 0 OVERSTATES the ', ...
103:                        'sag, so the model is pessimistic there - together ', ...
104:                        'with grid losses (zero here, 0.704 MW at X/R = 10) ', ...
105:                        'and generator MVAr (-16.8 % at X/R = 10). The cause ', ...
106:                        'is that this plant exports P and Q in a ratio near ', ...
107:                        '12.6 to 1, so R*P dominates X*Q and the usual ', ...
108:                        'mostly-reactive transmission intuition inverts. ', ...
109:                        'See matlab/data/assumptions/grid_series_resistance_zero.m'];
110: 
111: G.R_ohm             = 0;
112: G.R_Status          = 'ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION';
113: 
114: G.Z_ohm             = G.Vnom_V^2/(G.Ssc_MVA*1e6);
115: G.X_ohm             = sqrt(G.Z_ohm^2 - G.R_ohm^2);    % = Z_ohm since R = 0
116: G.X_Status          = 'ESTIMATED';
117: G.X_Source          = ['|Z| = V^2/S_sc = 2.65581124 ohm DERIVED from the §2.4 50 kA ', ...
118:                        'ESTIMATED Siemens source quantity. XN ≈ 2.66 is the ', ...
119:                        'separately-reported rounded estimate in §2.4, not an R/X pair. ', ...
120:                        'ESTIMATE, per approved answer Q1a.'];
121: G.L_H               = G.X_ohm/(2*pi*G.f_Hz);
122: G.L_Status          = 'DERIVED_FROM_VERIFIED_DATA';
123: G.L_Derivation      = 'L = X / (2*pi*50)';
124: 
125: % ---- Load-flow representation -----------------------------------------
126: G.LF_BusType        = 'swing';
127: G.Model_block       = 'sps_lib/Sources/Three-Phase Source';
128: G.Model_treatment   = 'ideal source + explicit external series branch';
129: G.Model_Note        = ['The source itself is IDEAL (NonIdealSource = off) ', ...
130:                        'and the equivalent impedance is a SEPARATE ', ...
131:                        'Three-Phase Series RLC Branch between BGRID230 and ', ...
132:                        'B230_REMOTE (Phase-3; plant bus B230_1 connects via ', ...
133:                        'the L_LINE PI section). This is deliberate and it matters: SPS ', ...
134:                        'enforces the swing voltage at the source TERMINAL, ', ...
135:                        'so an impedance placed INSIDE the source block ', ...
136:                        'would be bypassed by the load-flow voltage ', ...
137:                        'constraint and the grid would behave as infinitely ', ...
138:                        'stiff at B230_REMOTE. Putting it outside makes the ', ...
139:                        'boundary voltage genuinely respond to plant export.'];
140: G.InternalConnection = 'Yg';
141: G.InternalConnection_Status = 'ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION';
142: G.InternalConnection_Note   = ['The PGCB 230 kV network is effectively ', ...
143:                        'solidly earthed, but no earthing document is in the ', ...
144:                        'set. Yg is used. NO effect on a balanced load flow.'];
145: 
146: G.Qmin_MVAr         = -inf;
147: G.Qmax_MVAr         =  inf;
148: G.Qlim_Status       = 'NOT_APPLICABLE';
149: G.Qlim_Note         = 'A slack bus absorbs whatever the network requires, by definition.';
150: 
151: % ---- Expected effect, stated in advance so the result can be checked --
152: G.Expected_effect   = ['At full rated export (about 375 MW leaving the GSUT ', ...
153:                        'HV terminal) the boundary current is roughly 0.94 ', ...
154:                        'kA and the angle shift across the grid equivalent ', ...
155:                        'is about atan(P*X/V^2) = atan(375e6*2.656/230e3^2) ', ...
156:                        'which is near 1.1 deg, with only a small change in ', ...
157:                        'voltage magnitude. If the solved result departs far ', ...
158:                        'from this, the model is wrong, not the plant.'];
159: 
160: % ------------------------------------------------------------------------
161: % Integrity assertions
162: % ------------------------------------------------------------------------
163: assert(G.Vnom_V == 230000, 'ashuganj_grid: grid must be at 230 kV. No 400 kV in South scope.');
164: assert(G.f_Hz == 50, 'ashuganj_grid: grid must be 50 Hz, not the 60 Hz of the prior PSAF studies.');
165: assert(G.R_ohm == 0, 'ashuganj_grid: R must be 0 per approved answer Q1a.');
166: assert(G.X_ohm > 0 && G.X_ohm < 100, 'ashuganj_grid: grid X is out of any plausible range.');
167: assert(strcmp(G.Isc_Status,'ESTIMATED'), ...
168:     ['ashuganj_grid: the grid short-circuit figure must remain ESTIMATED. ', ...
169:      'It is the §2.4 Siemens estimated source quantity, not verified PGCB data.']);
170: assert(strcmp(G.X_Status,'ESTIMATED'), ...
171:     'ashuganj_grid: grid X must remain ESTIMATED.');
172: end

1: function L = ashuganj_lines()
2: %ASHUGANJ_LINES  Line / cable / series-branch database - Ashuganj SOUTH.
3: %
4: %   L = ASHUGANJ_LINES() returns a struct array of every series branch that
5: %   is NOT a transformer.  Most entries are deliberately zero-impedance: the
6: %   South plant is a compact single-shaft block with GIS, so the electrical
7: %   distances are short AND, more importantly, no cable or busduct impedance
8: %   is documented anywhere in the source set.  Rather than invent lengths and
9: %   impedances, those connections are modelled as direct nodes-in-common and
10: %   the omission is stated.
11: %
12: %   Approved answer Q7a: NO 70 km transmission line to a remote grid bus is
13: %   created.  The external-grid equivalent sits at the PLANT BOUNDARY.  The
14: %   one genuinely modelled series impedance is therefore the grid equivalent
15: %   itself, and it is an ESTIMATE, clearly labelled (approved answer Q1a).
16: %
17: %   See also ASHUGANJ_GRID, ASHUGANJ_MASTER_DATA.
18: 
19: k = 0; L = struct([]);
20: 
21: % =====================================================================
22: % 1.  The external grid equivalent series branch  (MODELLED)
23: % =====================================================================
24: % Placed as an EXPLICIT branch rather than inside the source block, because
25: % SPS enforces the swing voltage at the source TERMINAL: an internal source
26: % impedance would be short-circuited by the load-flow voltage constraint and
27: % would have no effect on the solved plant-boundary voltage.
28: k=k+1;
29: L(k).Name              = 'ZGRID';
30: L(k).Label             = 'GRID EQUIV Z';
31: L(k).Bus_from          = 'BGRID230';
32: L(k).Bus_to            = 'B230_REMOTE';
33: L(k).Placement_Note    = ['Phase-3: grid equivalent moved to remote bus; ', ...
34:                           'plant bus connects via L_LINE.'];
35: L(k).Vnom_V            = 230000;
36: L(k).Model_included    = true;
37: L(k).Model_block       = 'sps_lib/Passives/Three-Phase Series RLC Branch';
38: L(k).BranchType        = 'L';       % pure inductance: R is zero by Q1a
39: L(k).R_ohm             = 0;
40: L(k).R_Status          = 'ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION';
41: L(k).R_Note            = ['Q1a approved: the grid X/R ratio is NOT ', ...
42:                           'documented, so no resistance is invented. R = 0 ', ...
43:                           'makes the grid equivalent purely reactive, which ', ...
44:                           'is the standard treatment when X/R is unknown ', ...
45:                           'and which slightly OVERSTATES the reactive ', ...
46:                           'coupling and UNDERSTATES grid losses. See ', ...
47:                           'matlab/data/assumptions/grid_series_resistance_zero.m'];
48: L(k).X_ohm             = [];        % filled below from the grid data
49: L(k).X_Status          = 'ESTIMATED';
50: L(k).Length_km         = 0;
51: L(k).Length_Status     = 'NOT_APPLICABLE';
52: L(k).Length_Note       = ['Zero by construction. This is a Thevenin ', ...
53:                           'EQUIVALENT at the plant boundary, not a physical ', ...
54:                           'line, so it has no length, no charging ', ...
55:                           'capacitance and no thermal rating (Q7a).'];
56: L(k).C_F               = 0;
57: L(k).C_Status          = 'NOT_APPLICABLE';
58: 
59: % =====================================================================
60: % 1b. Locked 0.7 km lumped dual-circuit PI line  (MODELLED, Phase 3)
61: % =====================================================================
62: k=k+1;
63: L(k).Name = 'L_LINE';
64: L(k).Label = 'SOUTH GIS TO GRID 0.7KM D/C EQ (MALLARD REF)';
65: L(k).Bus_from = 'B230_1';
66: L(k).Bus_to = 'B230_REMOTE';
67: L(k).Vnom_V = 230000;
68: L(k).Model_included = true;
69: L(k).Model_block = 'sps_lib/Passives/Three-Phase PI Section Line';
70: L(k).BranchType = 'PI';
71: L(k).Length_km = 0.7;
72: L(k).Length_Status = 'ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION';
73: L(k).Length_Note = 'Locked Phase-3 EA: 0.7 km GIS-to-grid; INEL-112070-00-ELC-DE-0026 unavailable. 70 km retained only as documented 400-kV/North conflict; 44 km is the separate Ghorasal line.';
74: L(k).Physical_circuit_count = 2;
75: L(k).Model_representation = 'LUMPED_DUAL_CIRCUIT_PI';
76: L(k).Conductor_reference = 'MALLARD_795_MCM';
77: L(k).Conductor_Status = 'ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION';
78: L(k).R_ohm = 0.0277725;  L(k).R_Status = 'ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION';
79: L(k).R_Note = 'DERIVED_FROM_ENGINEERING_REFERENCE (human tier): (0.00015 pu/km*529)/2*0.7; ref Ghorasal-Mallard PGCB/JICA, NOT measured South link.';
80: L(k).X_ohm = 0.1425655;  L(k).X_Status = 'ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION';
81: L(k).X_Note = 'DERIVED_FROM_ENGINEERING_REFERENCE (human tier): (0.00077 pu/km*529)/2*0.7; same reference.';
82: L(k).C_F = 3.937996e-6/(2*pi*50);  L(k).C_Status = 'ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION';
83: L(k).C_Note = 'DERIVED_FROM_ENGINEERING_REFERENCE (human tier): B=3.937996 uS (2x1.968998) at 50 Hz; C=B/(2*pi*50).';
84: L(k).R0_ohm = NaN; L(k).R0_Status = 'MISSING';
85: L(k).X0_ohm = NaN; L(k).X0_Status = 'MISSING';
86: L(k).C0_F = NaN;   L(k).C0_Status = 'MISSING';
87: 
88: % =====================================================================
89: % 2.  230 kV GIS internal connections  (zero impedance)
90: % =====================================================================
91: k=k+1;
92: L(k).Name              = 'BAY_GSUT';
93: L(k).Label             = 'BAY 10BAY11';
94: L(k).Bus_from          = 'B230_1';

101: L(k).Rated_A_Source    = ['GIS Data Sheet_230KV Generator Transformer module 2000 A ', ...
102:                           '(REV3 §3.6 units-column audit; Line module 2000 A, ', ...
103:                           'Bus coupler module 3150 A — 3150 A is coupler/busbar only). ', ...
104:                           'Conductor ampacity MISSING, never this module rating.'];
105: L(k).Exclusion_reason  = ['GIS bay 10BAY11 (Q0 circuit-breaker, Q1 to ', ...
106:                            'BUS 2, Q2 to BUS 1, Q9 earthing switch). The ', ...
107:                            'busduct and bay impedances are MISSING and are ', ...
108:                            'in any case negligible against the GSUT 16 %%. ', ...
109:                            'The GSUT HV terminal is therefore the SAME ', ...
110:                            'electrical node as B230_1.'];
111: L(k).Notes             = ['Double-busbar single-breaker: the bay can be ', ...
112:                           'selected to BUS 1 or BUS 2 via Q2/Q1. Approved ', ...
113:                           'answer Q10a: with the coupler closed the ', ...
114:                           'selection does not materially affect the ', ...
115:                           'balanced network, so GSUT is shown on BUS 1.'];
116: 
117: k=k+1;
118: L(k).Name              = 'BAY_GAT';
119: L(k).Label             = 'BAY 10BAY20';
120: L(k).Bay_label_note    = ['REV3.1 reconciliation: Label corrected 10BAY12->10BAY20 per ', ...
121:                           'REV3 C-17 (BAY_GAT=10BAY20) + GIS SLD GAT(F13) 10BAY20 + builder ', ...
122:                           'GAT BAY CB 10BAY20 convention. Prior 10BAY12 was the bus-coupler/protection ', ...
123:                           'panel designation, not the GAT bay — recorded as panel-label conflict, now resolved.'];
124: L(k).Bus_from          = 'B230_2';
125: L(k).Bus_to            = 'GAT_HV';
126: L(k).Vnom_V            = 230000;
127: L(k).Model_included    = false;
128: L(k).Model_treatment   = 'direct connection (zero impedance) + switching breaker';
129: L(k).Rated_A           = 2000;
130: L(k).Rated_A_Status    = 'VERIFIED_ENGINEERING_DOCUMENT';
131: L(k).Rated_A_Source    = ['Transformer-bay class 2000 A: GIS SLD shows GAT(F13) 10BAY20 with Q0 breaker ', ...
132:                           '(same Q0 designation as GSUT bay); CB datasheet headed TRANSFORMER BAY carries ', ...
133:                           '2000 A continuous (REV3 §3.6b/C-36, Q0-verified); module table GT 2000 A / Line 2000 A / ', ...
134:                           'Coupler 3150 A (REV3 §3.6). Conductor ampacity MISSING, never this module rating.'];
135: L(k).Exclusion_reason  = ['As BAY_GSUT. The bay IMPEDANCE is omitted, but ', ...
136:                           'the bay CIRCUIT-BREAKER is modelled explicitly ', ...
137:                           'because approved answer Q4c requires the GAT to ', ...
138:                           'be switched in and out between cases.'];
139: L(k).Notes             = 'GAT shown on BUS 2 so that the loop crosses the coupler.';
140: 
141: k=k+1;
142: L(k).Name              = 'BAY_GRID';
143: L(k).Label             = 'LINE BAY (bay number MISSING — NOT 10BAY20)';
144: L(k).Bay_label_note    = ['REV3.1 reconciliation: prior Label BAY 10BAY20 collided with corrected BAY_GAT=10BAY20; ', ...
145:                           '10BAY11/12/20 are GSUT/coupler/GAT per SLD+builder convention, so the outgoing line-bay number ', ...

function Z = build_gsut_system(mdl, D)

%
%   Z = BUILD_GSUT_SYSTEM(MDL, D) adds GSUT 10BAT10 to model MDL. The block's
%   position comes from SPS_GEOM: it stands in the GSUT column and spans the
%   230 kV BUS 1 tier down to the 22 kV GEN BUS tier, because its two winding
%   terminals ARE those two bus nodes. SPS_GEOM asserts that span, so the
%   transformer cannot drift off either busbar without the build stopping.
%
%   GSUT 10BAT10 : 230/22 kV, ONAN/ODAN/ODAF 355/460/515 MVA, YNd1,
%                  OLTC 25 taps on HV, principal tap 9 = 230000 V,
%                  Z = 16 % and R = 0.21 % at 515 MVA,
%                  no-load loss 159 kW, load loss 523/874/1095 kW.
%
%   The block is oriented 'down' so that the 230 kV winding is on top and the
%   22 kV winding at the bottom, which is how a plant one-line diagram is
%   drawn. Winding 1 stays the HV winding, exactly as the nameplate lists it,

%   230000 V exactly, so the modelled ratio is precisely nominal. Taps are

                g.box(cx, g.tier.bus1, g.tx), 'down');

set_param(Z.tx, 'BackgroundColor', g.clr.fill230, ...
                'ForegroundColor', g.clr.v230);

% Tag, ratio, vector group, rating, impedance - and stop. The derived detail

% table at the foot of the diagram, where it can be read as a table instead of
% competing with the one-line for space. A plant drawing captions a transformer
% in three lines and so does this.
%
% Annotation Position is only honoured at its left and top edge - Simulink
% refits the right and bottom to the text - so these are anchors and the space
% to the right of them is left deliberately clear.
sps_wire('note', mdl, 'GSUT  10BAT10', ...
    [cx+58, g.tier.bus1+14, cx+238, g.tier.bus1+36], 11, 'bold', g.clr.v230);
sps_wire('note', mdl, sprintf(['230/22 kV  YNd1  Z = %.1f %%\n' ...
    '355/460/515 MVA  ONAN/ODAN/ODAF\ntap %d/%d = %g V (principal)'], ...
    t.Z_pct, t.Tap_used, t.Tap_positions, t.Tap_V_used_V), ...
    [cx+58, g.tier.bus1+40, cx+298, g.tier.bus1+94], 9, 'normal');

Z.report = pack_report(t);
end

% =====================================================================
function apply_transformer_params(blk, t)
%APPLY_TRANSFORMER_PARAMS  Populate one SPS two-winding transformer block.
%   Shared by the GSUT and auxiliary zone builders so that the parameter
%   mapping exists in exactly one place.
set_param(blk, ...
    'UNITS',              'pu', ...
    'NominalPower',       sprintf('[ %.10g , %.10g ]', t.S_rating_MVA*1e6, t.f_Hz), ...
    'Winding1',           sprintf('[ %.10g , %.12g , %.12g ]', t.V_HV_V, t.R1_pu, t.L1_pu), ...
    'Winding2',           sprintf('[ %.10g , %.12g , %.12g ]', t.V_LV_V, t.R2_pu, t.L2_pu), ...
    'Winding1Connection', t.Conn_HV, ...
    'Winding2Connection', t.Conn_LV, ...
    'CoreType',           t.Model_coretype, ...
    'SetSaturation',      t.Model_saturation, ...
    'Rm',                 sprintf('%.10g', t.Rm_pu), ...
    'Lm',                 sprintf('%.10g', t.Lm_pu), ...
    'L0',                 sprintf('%.10g', t.L0_pu));
sps_wire('setopt', blk, 'Measurements', 'None');
end

% =====================================================================
function r = pack_report(t)
r = struct('Name', t.Name, 'V_HV_V', t.V_HV_V, 'V_LV_V', t.V_LV_V, ...
           'S_rating_MVA', t.S_rating_MVA, 'S_MVA', t.S_MVA, ...
           'Z_pct', t.Z_pct, 'R_pct', t.R_pct, 'X_pct', t.X_pct, ...
           'XR', t.XR_ratio, 'Rm_pu', t.Rm_pu, 'Lm_pu', t.Lm_pu, ...
           'Conn_HV', t.Conn_HV, 'Conn_LV', t.Conn_LV, ...
           'VectorGroup', t.VectorGroup, 'Tap', t.Tap_used);
end

22: %   INWARD-FLOW JUSTIFICATION (locked detection rule): internal fault + max
23: %   terminal branch >= sourced pickup -> ASSERTABLE-DETECT; else
24: %   NOT-DETERMINABLE, never invented. Every B leg magnitude derives from the
25: %   frozen phase4_contrib legs re-signed TOWARD THE FAULT (phase4_contrib.m
26: %   header lines 20-35: every leg re-signed toward the fault, then
27: %   phase-reconstructed per leg with Fortescue), so at an internal fault
28: %   every zone terminal feeds inward and the differential sum is the
29: %   magnitude sum. GEN-87G detection is therefore assertable exactly when
30: %   the GEN terminal faulted-phase branch meets the sourced 87G pickup
31: %   (0.20 x 12019 = 2403.8 A from the GEN-87G registry row,
32: %   USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC + master-S21 Status-C corroboration).
33: %   GSUT-87T carries presence only (7UT6331 settings missing, registry
34: %   pickup NaN) so its assertability rests on the master-S21 Status-C
35: %   transformer-differential starting assumption (ledger TR-DIFF-0.30pu,
36: %   ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION) applied to the Siemens nameplate base:
37: %   start threshold 0.30 x Siemens nameplate HV rated current IN 1292.8 A
38: %   (Generator Data_South.pdf pp.6-7 S2.2.1: "Rated current IN 1.292,8 A"
39: %   -> 387.84 A), quoted in every F2 reason with provenance
40: %   label master-S21-Status-C-starting-assumption-applied-to-Siemens-nameplate-base.
41: %   GIS-87B / LINE-7SD carry
42: %   presence only with no sourced pickup anywhere (registry pickup NaN),
43: %   so they are always NOT-DETERMINABLE: the reason reports the kA-scale
44: %   inward magnitude observation (F3: GSUT_HV + LINE_total + GRID infeeds;
45: %   F4: LINE_B1 + LINE_B2 sections) with live values but asserts no
46: %   detection. Timing for 87T/87B/7SD always stays NaN (settings missing,
47: %   never 45 ms).
48: %
49: %   F4 DOCTRINE (binding carry-over 2): at F4 the B1/B2 leg rows are used,
50: %   never the LINE_total cancellation residual (~1e-13 kA at LL/LLG, where
51: %   the two toward-fault infeeds cancel in the unfaulted-phase sum). The
52: %   GIS-side backup current is the LINE_B1 GIS-side section outfeed.
53: %
54: %   BACKUP TIMES (binding carry-over 3): from the v2 study inputs (C4
55: %   pickups 1.20x14309 = 17170.8 A GEN-51-SI, 1380 A GSUT-HV-51, GIS
56: %   1.2x869.9567 A formula, 5 A GEN-51N-SI-STUDY; TMS 0.20 phase / 0.15 EF;
57: %   1600/1 study CTs) via the frozen phase5_time/phase5_curve library
58: %   (read-only use; settings obtained from phase5b_pickup, never
59: %   hard-coded). Faulted-phase branch magnitudes come from B
60: %   (Ibranch_faulted_A: maxABC at LLL, Ia at LG, maxBC at LL/LLG); the only
61: %   T40 magnitude column read is the NER series leg (leg_NER_earth_kA),
62: %   whose neutral current has I1 = I2 = 0 so its |Ia| serves all phases and
63: %   3x gives the 3I0 residual exactly (F1 LG sensitivity scope). Fault-point
64: %   totals are never a proxy for relay current. Siemens-baseline backup
65: %   rows (DT-??) respect use_phase5_time == false: backup_time NaN with the
66: %   ?? pending-coordination reason, never dispatched to the frozen
67: %   operating-time entry point.
68: %
69: %   PRIMARY TIME (binding carry-over 4): 0.045 s derived fast-main clearing
70: %   ONLY where 87-class detection is assertable AND the interrupting breaker
71: %   is identified (F1/87G + GEN-52G GCB 10BAC10 100 kA) -- else NaN with a
72: %   reason; 87T timing NaN (0.30pu start assumption only, 7UT6331 settings
73: %   missing); 7SD/87B timing NaN (no sourced pickup, settings missing).
74: %
75: %   GEN LLG RESIDUAL (binding carry-over 5): the C6 out-of-51N-scope note
76: %   (F1-LLG OUT 3I0 3.638 A observed; 51N study basis is LG-only) appears in
77: %   every LLG row's not_determinable text with the live 3xNER quote.
78: %
79: %   Backup mapping: F1+LG -> GEN-51N-SI-STUDY (EF; phase element honestly
80: %   blind there per C6); F1 otherwise -> GEN-51-SI; F2 -> GSUT-HV-51;
81: %   F3/F4/F5 -> GIS-Q0-51 (F4 via LINE_B1, F3/F5 via LINE_total through
82: %   convention). F5 (remote, out-of-zone, no zone primary mapped) is always
83: %   NOT-DETERMINABLE with a remote-backup time.
84: %
85: %   All errors are 'phase5b'-prefixed.
86: if nargin ~= 2
87:     error('phase5b_effectiveness:args', 'usage: E = phase5b_effectiveness(T40, devices).');
88: end
89: if ~istable(T40) || height(T40) < 1
90:     error('phase5b_effectiveness:schema', 'T40 must be a non-empty table (phase5_import backbone).');
91: end
92: needCols = {'fault_location', 'fault_type', 'caseID', 'leg_NER_earth_kA'};
93: for k = 1:numel(needCols)
94:     if ~any(strcmp(T40.Properties.VariableNames, needCols{k}))
95:         error('phase5b_effectiveness:schema', 'T40 missing required column %s.', needCols{k});
96:     end
97: end
98: if ~isstruct(devices) || isempty(devices) || ~isfield(devices, 'device_id')
99:     error('phase5b_effectiveness:devices', 'devices must be a non-empty struct array with device_id (registry rows).');
100: end
101: 
102: % --- Single branch-phasor recompute (~5 min); rows below reuse B. ---
103: B = phase5b_branch_phasors(T40);
104: 
105: % --- Sourced references from the registry (never hard-coded pickups). ---
106: d87 = devrow(devices, 'GEN-87G');
107: if ~isfield(d87, 'pickup_A') || ~isfinite(d87.pickup_A)
108:     error('phase5b_effectiveness:pickup', 'GEN-87G registry row must carry the sourced 0.20pu start pickup (never invented).');
109: end
110: IS87 = double(d87.pickup_A);  % 0.20 x 12019 = 2403.8 A
111: has52G = ~isempty(findDevice(devices, 'GEN-52G'));
112: genD = reqdev(devices, 'GEN-51');
113: efD = reqdev(devices, 'GEN-51N');
114: gsutD = reqdev(devices, 'GSUT-HV-51');
115: gisD = reqdev(devices, 'GIS-Q0-51');
116: blD = reqdev(devices, 'GEN-51-SIEMENS-BL');
117: d87T = devrow(devices, 'GSUT-87T');  % presence only; 87T threshold base is the Siemens nameplate IN below, never the registry study rating
118: GSUT_HV_BASE_A = 1292.8;  % Siemens nameplate HV rated current IN (Generator Data_South.pdf pp.6-7 S2.2.1: "Rated current IN 1.292,8 A"); master-S21-Status-C-starting-assumption applied to Siemens nameplate base
119: TRDIFF_START_PU = 0.30;  % ledger TR-DIFF-0.30pu transformer-differential bias/start (ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION)
120: I87T_START_A = TRDIFF_START_PU * GSUT_HV_BASE_A;  % 0.30 x 1292.8 = 387.84 A start threshold (never a relay setting)
121: ILOAD_GEN = 14309;              % ledger GEN-Imax-14309 (C4 basis)
122: ILOAD_GSUT = 870.772573866956;  % GSUT_HV flow anchor (rule takes max with rated 1150 A)
123: ILOAD_GIS = 869.956651959241;   % LINE_Q9 flow anchor from ct_data FL_anchor
124: 
125: floc = cell(0, 1); ftyp = cell(0, 1); cids = cell(0, 1);
126: pfunc = cell(0, 1); pavail = cell(0, 1); ptime = zeros(0, 1);
127: bfunc = cell(0, 1); btime = zeros(0, 1);
128: ctsrc = cell(0, 1); setsrc = cell(0, 1); det = cell(0, 1);
129: determ = false(0, 1); ndet = cell(0, 1);
130: 
131: n = height(T40);
132: for i = 1:n
133:     loc = aschar(T40.fault_location(i));
134:     typ = aschar(T40.fault_type(i));
135:     cs = aschar(T40.caseID(i));
136:     ner = double(T40.leg_NER_earth_kA(i));  % kA, finite only at LG/LLG
137: 
138:     % === PRIMARY (zone-mapped; detection-vs-timing split) ===
139:     switch loc
140:         case 'F1'
141:             pf = 'GEN-87G';
142:             gI = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'GEN');
143:             if isfinite(gI) && gI >= IS87
144:                 pa = 'ASSERTABLE-DETECT';
145:                 if has52G
146:                     tp = 0.045;  % derived fast-main clearing: 87G + 52G/10BAC10 identified
147:                     tNote = sprintf(['primary-87G-ASSERTABLE-DETECT-GEN-terminal-%.1fA->=' ...
148:                         'sourced-pickup-0.20x12019-%.1fA;' ...
149:                         'primary_time-0.045s-derived-fast-main-clearing-87G-plus-' ...
150:                         'breaker-52G-10BAC10-100kA-identified'], gI, IS87);
151:                 else
152:                     tp = NaN;
153:                     tNote = sprintf(['primary-87G-ASSERTABLE-DETECT-GEN-terminal-%.1fA;' ...
154:                         'primary_time-NaN-breaker-52G-not-identified-trip-matrix-' ...
155:                         'NOT-DETERMINABLE'], gI);
156:                 end
157:                 psrc = ['USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC:SIEMENS-87G-0.20-START-' ...
158:                     'PENDING-DOC-INGEST-master-S21-Status-C-corroborated'];
159:                 cts = ['SOURCE-BACKED:GEN-T1T2-15000/1-3cores-' ...
160:                     'ledger-GEN-T1T2-15000-primary-CT'];
161:             else
162:                 pa = 'NOT-DETERMINABLE';
163:                 tp = NaN;
164:                 tNote = sprintf(['primary-87G-NOT-DETERMINABLE-GEN-terminal-%.3gA-' ...
165:                     'below-sourced-pickup-%.1fA-or-missing;' ...
166:                     'primary_time-NaN-no-assertable-detection'], gI, IS87);
167:                 psrc = ['USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC:SIEMENS-87G-0.20-START-' ...
168:                     'PENDING-DOC-INGEST-master-S21-Status-C-corroborated'];
169:                 cts = ['SOURCE-BACKED:GEN-T1T2-15000/1-3cores-' ...
170:                     'ledger-GEN-T1T2-15000-primary-CT'];
171:             end
172:         case 'F2'
173:             pf = 'GSUT-87T';
174:             aI = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'GEN');
175:             bI = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'GSUT_HV');
176:             psrc = ['SOURCE-BACKED:PROT-7UT6331-presence-settings-MISSING-' ...
177:                 'ledger-TR-DIFF-0.30pu-0.30pu-start-ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION-' ...
178:                 'master-S21-Status-C-starting-assumption-applied-to-Siemens-' ...
179:                 'nameplate-base-HV-IN-1292.8A-Generator-Data-South-pp6-7-S2.2.1-' ...
180:                 'differential-timing-NOT-DETERMINABLE'];
181:             cts = ['SOURCE-BACKED:GSUT-HV-1600/1-cores-HV-' ...
182:                 'ledger-GSUT-1600/1-cores-plus-GEN-T1T2-15000/1-differential-terminals'];
183:             if isfinite(aI) && isfinite(bI) && aI >= I87T_START_A && bI >= I87T_START_A
184:                 pa = 'ASSERTABLE-DETECT';
185:                 tp = NaN;
186:                 tNote = sprintf(['primary-GSUT-87T-ASSERTABLE-DETECT-internal-' ...
187:                     'transformer-fault-inward-GEN-%.1fA-plus-GSUT_HV-%.1fA-' ...
188:                     'vs-start-0.30pu-x-Siemens-nameplate-HV-base-%.1fA-=%.2fA-' ...
189:                     'master-S21-Status-C-starting-assumption-applied-to-Siemens-' ...
190:                     'nameplate-base-ledger-TR-DIFF-0.30pu;' ...
191:                     'primary_time-NaN-GSUT-87T-7UT6331-settings-missing-' ...
192:                     'timing-NOT-DETERMINABLE-never-45ms'], aI, bI, GSUT_HV_BASE_A, I87T_START_A);
193:             else
194:                 pa = 'NOT-DETERMINABLE';
195:                 tp = NaN;
196:                 tNote = sprintf(['primary-GSUT-87T-NOT-DETERMINABLE-vs-start-' ...
197:                     '0.30pu-x-Siemens-nameplate-HV-base-%.1fA-=%.2fA-' ...
198:                     'master-S21-Status-C-starting-assumption-applied-to-Siemens-' ...
199:                     'nameplate-base-ledger-TR-DIFF-0.30pu-' ...
200:                     'inward-GEN-%.3gA-GSUT_HV-%.3gA;' ...
201:                     'primary_time-NaN-GSUT-87T-settings-missing'], GSUT_HV_BASE_A, I87T_START_A, aI, bI);
202:             end
203:         case 'F3'
204:             pf = 'GIS-87B';
205:             aI = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'GSUT_HV');
206:             bI = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'LINE_total');
207:             cI = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'GRID');
208:             psrc = ['SOURCE-BACKED:PROT-7SS523-presence-settings-MISSING-' ...
209:                 'differential-timing-NOT-DETERMINABLE'];
210:             cts = ['SOURCE-BACKED:GIS-bay-1600/1-5P20-30VA-' ...
211:                 'ledger-GIS-bay-1600/1-study-CT'];
212:             % No sourced 7SS523 pickup exists (registry pickup NaN): never assert;
213:             % the reason below reports the live inward magnitudes with no detection.
214:             pa = 'NOT-DETERMINABLE';
215:             tp = NaN;
216:             tNote = sprintf(['primary-GIS-87B-NOT-DETERMINABLE-no-sourced-' ...
217:                 '7SS523-pickup-registry-pickup-NaN-presence-only-kA-scale-' ...
218:                 'magnitude-observation-inward-GSUT_HV-%.1fA-plus-LINE-%.1fA-' ...
219:                 'plus-GRID-%.1fA-no-detection-asserted;' ...
220:                 'primary_time-NaN-GIS-87B-7SS523-settings-missing-' ...
221:                 'timing-NOT-DETERMINABLE-never-45ms'], aI, bI, cI);
222:         case 'F4'
223:             pf = 'LINE-7SD';
224:             aI = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'LINE_B1');
225:             bI = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'LINE_B2');
226:             psrc = ['SOURCE-BACKED:PROT-7SD5221x2-2x7SD5221-presence-' ...
227:                 'settings-MISSING-differential-timing-NOT-DETERMINABLE'];
228:             cts = ['SOURCE-BACKED:GIS-bay-1600/1-5P20-30VA-' ...
229:                 'ledger-GIS-bay-1600/1-study-CT'];
230:             % No sourced 7SD5221 pickup exists (registry pickup NaN): never assert;
231:             % the reason below reports the live section magnitudes with no detection.
232:             pa = 'NOT-DETERMINABLE';
233:             tp = NaN;
234:             tNote = sprintf(['primary-LINE-7SD-NOT-DETERMINABLE-no-sourced-' ...
235:                 '7SD5221-pickup-registry-pickup-NaN-presence-only-kA-scale-' ...
236:                 'magnitude-observation-inward-LINE_B1-GIS-side-%.1fA-plus-' ...
237:                 'LINE_B2-remote-side-%.1fA-no-detection-asserted;' ...
238:                 'primary_time-NaN-LINE-7SD-7SD5221x2-settings-missing-' ...
239:                 'timing-NOT-DETERMINABLE-never-45ms'], aI, bI);
240:         otherwise  % F5: remote, out-of-zone, no zone primary mapped
241:             pf = 'NONE-no-zone-primary-mapped';
242:             pa = 'NOT-DETERMINABLE';
243:             tp = NaN;
244:             tNote = ['primary-NOT-DETERMINABLE-out-of-zone-F5-remote-grid-' ...
245:                 'fault-no-zone-primary-mapped-no-87-class-in-zone;' ...
246:                 'primary_time-NaN-no-primary-mapped'];
247:             psrc = 'NONE-no-zone-primary-mapped-out-of-zone-no-setting-source';
248:             cts = ['SOURCE-BACKED:GIS-bay-1600/1-5P20-30VA-' ...
249:                 'ledger-GIS-bay-1600/1-study-CT'];
250:     end
251: 
252:     % === STUDY BACKUP (v2 C4 inputs via phase5b_pickup; frozen operating time) ===
253:     if strcmp(loc, 'F1') && strcmp(typ, 'LG')
254:         bf = 'GEN-51N-SI-STUDY';
255:         dev = efD;
256:         Iload = 0;
257:         I = 3 * ner * 1000;  % 3I0 from the NER series leg (LG sensitivity scope)
258:         scopeNote = sprintf(['backup-EF-5A-retained-sensitive-case-scope-' ...
259:             'SENSITIVITY-C4-LG-basis-must-detect-F1-LG-3I0-%.3fA;' ...
260:             'phase-element-blind-at-F1-LG-C6-EF-element-covers'], I);
261:     elseif strcmp(loc, 'F1')
262:         bf = 'GEN-51-SI';
263:         dev = genD;
264:         Iload = ILOAD_GEN;
265:         I = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'GEN');
266:         scopeNote = sprintf('backup-phase-GEN-terminal-faulted-phase-%.1fA', I);
267:     elseif strcmp(loc, 'F2')
268:         bf = 'GSUT-HV-51';
269:         dev = gsutD;
270:         Iload = ILOAD_GSUT;
271:         I = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'GSUT_HV');
272:         scopeNote = sprintf('backup-phase-GSUT_HV-terminal-faulted-phase-%.1fA', I);
273:     elseif strcmp(loc, 'F4')
274:         bf = 'GIS-Q0-51';
275:         dev = gisD;
276:         Iload = ILOAD_GIS;
277:         I = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'LINE_B1');  % GIS-side section outfeed, never the cancellation residual
278:         scopeNote = sprintf(['backup-via-LINE_B1-GIS-side-outfeed-%.1fA-' ...
279:             'NEVER-LINE_total-cancellation-residual'], I);
280:     else  % F3 / F5: through-convention outfeed
281:         bf = 'GIS-Q0-51';
282:         dev = gisD;
283:         Iload = ILOAD_GIS;
284:         I = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'LINE_total');
285:         scopeNote = sprintf('backup-via-LINE_total-through-convention-%.1fA', I);
286:     end
287:     if isfinite(I) && I > 0
288:         IminArg = I;
289:     else
290:         IminArg = 1;  % shapes validation text only; setting is load-based
291:     end
292:     P = phase5b_pickup(dev, Iload, IminArg);
293:     if ~P.use_phase5_time
294:         tb = NaN;
295:         bNote = [scopeNote ';backup_time-NaN-use_phase5_time-false-never-dispatched'];
296:     elseif isfinite(I) && I > 0
297:         tb = phase5_time(I, P.setting, P.tms, P.curve);
298:         bNote = sprintf([scopeNote '-vs-pickup-%.4fA-SI-TMS-%.2f-time-%.4fs-via-frozen-phase5_time'], ...
299:             P.setting, P.tms, tb);
300:     else
301:         tb = NaN;
302:         bNote = [scopeNote ';backup_time-NaN-backup-current-not-finite-or-missing-no-trip-invented'];
303:     end
304:     ssrc = ['primary:' psrc ' | backup:' P.source];
305: 
306:     % === LLG residual context (C6 out-of-51N-scope note, live quote) ===
307:     if strcmp(typ, 'LLG')
308:         if isfinite(ner)
309:             llgNote = sprintf(['GEN-LLG-residual-3I0-%.3fA-observed-' ...
310:                 'out-of-51N-scope-C4-LG-basis-only-C6-OUT-anchor-3.638A'], 3 * ner * 1000);
311:         else
312:             llgNote = ['GEN-LLG-residual-NER-leg-unavailable-here-' ...
313:                 'out-of-51N-scope-C4-LG-basis-only-C6-OUT-anchor-3.638A'];
314:         end
315:     else
316:         llgNote = '';
317:     end
318:     if isempty(llgNote)
319:         ndText = [tNote ';' bNote];
320:     else
321:         ndText = [tNote ';' bNote ';' llgNote];
322:     end
323: 
324:     floc{end+1, 1} = loc; %#ok<AGROW>
325:     ftyp{end+1, 1} = typ; %#ok<AGROW>
326:     cids{end+1, 1} = cs; %#ok<AGROW>
327:     pfunc{end+1, 1} = pf; %#ok<AGROW>
328:     pavail{end+1, 1} = pa; %#ok<AGROW>
329:     ptime(end+1, 1) = tp; %#ok<AGROW>
330:     bfunc{end+1, 1} = bf; %#ok<AGROW>
331:     btime(end+1, 1) = tb; %#ok<AGROW>
332:     ctsrc{end+1, 1} = cts; %#ok<AGROW>
333:     setsrc{end+1, 1} = ssrc; %#ok<AGROW>
334:     det{end+1, 1} = pa; %#ok<AGROW>
335:     determ(end+1, 1) = strcmp(pa, 'ASSERTABLE-DETECT'); %#ok<AGROW>
336:     ndet{end+1, 1} = ndText; %#ok<AGROW>
337: 
338:     % === SIEMENS-BASELINE BACKUP TWIN (F1 generator-zone rows only) ===
339:     if strcmp(loc, 'F1')
340:         Pb = phase5b_pickup(blD, ILOAD_GEN, IminArg);
341:         if ~Pb.use_phase5_time
342:             tbb = NaN;
343:             bbNote = ['Siemens-baseline-backup-NaN-DT-??-tdef-3.00s-??-' ...
344:                 'PENDING-COORDINATION-inverse-prohibited-use_phase5_time-' ...
345:                 'false-never-dispatched-to-frozen-operating-time'];
346:         else
347:             tbb = NaN;
348:             bbNote = ['Siemens-baseline-backup-NaN-unexpected-use_phase5_time-' ...
349:                 'true-guarded-NaN-never-tuned'];
350:         end
351:         bsrc = ['primary:' psrc ' | backup:' Pb.source];
352:         floc{end+1, 1} = loc; %#ok<AGROW>
353:         ftyp{end+1, 1} = typ; %#ok<AGROW>
354:         cids{end+1, 1} = cs; %#ok<AGROW>
355:         pfunc{end+1, 1} = pf; %#ok<AGROW>
356:         pavail{end+1, 1} = pa; %#ok<AGROW>
357:         ptime(end+1, 1) = tp; %#ok<AGROW>
358:         bfunc{end+1, 1} = 'GEN-51-SIEMENS-BL'; %#ok<AGROW>
359:         btime(end+1, 1) = tbb; %#ok<AGROW>
360:         ctsrc{end+1, 1} = cts; %#ok<AGROW>
361:         setsrc{end+1, 1} = bsrc; %#ok<AGROW>
362:         det{end+1, 1} = pa; %#ok<AGROW>
363:         determ(end+1, 1) = strcmp(pa, 'ASSERTABLE-DETECT'); %#ok<AGROW>
364:         if isempty(llgNote)
365:             ndet{end+1, 1} = [tNote ';' bbNote]; %#ok<AGROW>
366:         else
367:             ndet{end+1, 1} = [tNote ';' bbNote ';' llgNote]; %#ok<AGROW>
368:         end
369:     end

380: function s = aschar(v)
381: %ASCHAR  Cell/string scalar to trimmed char.
382: if isstring(v) && isscalar(v)
383:     v = char(v);
384: end
385: if iscell(v) && isscalar(v)
386:     v = v{1};
387:     if isstring(v) && isscalar(v)
388:         v = char(v);
389:     end
390: end
391: s = strtrim(char(v));
392: end

394: function I = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, leg)
395: %BEGET  Faulted-phase branch magnitude (A) for one B-table leg; NaN if absent.
396: hit = strcmp(B.caseID, cs) & strcmp(B.location, loc) ...
397:     & strcmp(B.fault_type, typ) & strcmp(B.leg, leg);
398: if sum(hit) == 1
399:     I = double(B.Ibranch_faulted_A(hit));
400: else
401:     I = NaN;
402: end
403: end
