224: function TiJ = join_production_peaks(root, Ti)
225: %JOIN_PRODUCTION_PEAKS  Iseq0_kA + r_kappa_ip from currents CSV (v1 T(b)+(c)).
226: %   Backbone-first dedup identical to phase5_import, inner join on
227: %   (caseID,location,fault_type). Every import row must hit, else
228: %   phase5b_production:join (never silently NaN-filled).
229: Fp = fullfile(root, 'results', 'phase4_fault', 'production', 'phase4_fault_currents.csv');
230: C = readtable(Fp);
231: for k = 1:numel({'fault_type', 'location', 'm', 'caseID', 'stage', 'Iseq0_kA', 'r_kappa_ip'})
232:     need = {'fault_type', 'location', 'm', 'caseID', 'stage', 'Iseq0_kA', 'r_kappa_ip'};
233:     if ~any(strcmp(C.Properties.VariableNames, need{k}))
234:         error('phase5b_production:schema', 'production currents CSV missing column %s.', need{k});
235:     end
236: end
237: Cb = C(strcmp(C.stage, 'Ikpp') & C.m == 0.5, :);
238: keys = strcat(Cb.caseID, '|', Cb.location, '|', Cb.fault_type);
239: [~, ia] = unique(keys, 'stable');
240: Cb = Cb(ia, :);
241: n = height(Ti);
242: Iseq0 = NaN(n, 1); rkp = NaN(n, 1);
243: tloc = tocell(Ti.fault_location); ttyp = tocell(Ti.fault_type); tcs = tocell(Ti.caseID);
244: bloc = tocell(Cb.location); btyp = tocell(Cb.fault_type); bcs = tocell(Cb.caseID);
245: for i = 1:n
246:     hit = find(strcmp(bcs, tcs{i}) & strcmp(bloc, tloc{i}) & strcmp(btyp, ttyp{i}), 1, 'first');
247:     if isempty(hit)
248:         error('phase5b_production:join', ...
249:             'production currents join missed %s %s %s (backbone keys diverged).', ...
250:             tcs{i}, tloc{i}, ttyp{i});
251:     end
252:     Iseq0(i) = Cb.Iseq0_kA(hit);
253:     rkp(i) = Cb.r_kappa_ip(hit);
254: end
255: if any(~isfinite(Iseq0)) || any(~isfinite(rkp))
256:     error('phase5b_production:join', 'joined Iseq0_kA/r_kappa_ip must be finite on all 40 backbone rows.');
257: end
258: TiJ = Ti;
259: TiJ.Iseq0_kA = Iseq0;
260: TiJ.r_kappa_ip = rkp;
261: end

475: function Trc = relay_currents_table_v2(Mtrx, TiJ)
476: %RELAY_CURRENTS_TABLE_V2  One row per finite matrix side + I0 context.
477: %   I_primary = I_secondary x CT_device (matrix sides are secondary amperes;
478: %   CTs are v2 15000/1600 via the graded matrix). Secondary arithmetic is
479: %   frozen phase5_ct (the single source of truth; the phase5_ct_table
480: %   wrapper rejects 1600 by locked guard and frozen files stay untouched).
481: %   I0_A joins real production Iseq0; LG-exact If/3 only when the join
482: %   truly lacks I0; LLG-without-Iseq0 -> NaN, never invented.
483: ml = tocell(Mtrx.fault_location); mt = tocell(Mtrx.fault_type); mc = tocell(Mtrx.caseID);
484: jl = tocell(TiJ.fault_location); jt = tocell(TiJ.fault_type); jc = tocell(TiJ.caseID);
485: Jseq = double(TiJ.Iseq0_kA(:)); Jtot = double(TiJ.I_primary_A(:));
486: oLoc = {}; oTyp = {}; oCase = {}; oDev = {}; oSide = {};
487: oIp = []; oIk = []; oCt = []; oIs = []; oI0 = []; oSrc = {};
488: oProv = {}; oScope = {};
489: PROV = ['SOURCE-BACKED:Phase-4-production-import-branch-through-current-via-frozen-phase5_coord;' ...
490:     'secondaries-via-frozen-phase5_ct-arithmetic-v2-CTs-15000-gen-1600-GSUT-GIS'];
491: for i = 1:height(Mtrx)
492:     j = find(strcmp(jc, mc{i}) & strcmp(jl, ml{i}) & strcmp(jt, mt{i}), 1, 'first');
493:     if isempty(j)
494:         error('phase5b_production:join', ...
495:             'relay-currents join missed %s %s %s.', mc{i}, ml{i}, mt{i});
496:     end
497:     if isfinite(Jseq(j))
498:         i0 = Jseq(j) * 1000;
499:         src = 'Iseq0-SOURCE-BACKED-Phase-4-production';
500:     elseif strcmp(mt{i}, 'LG')
501:         i0 = Jtot(j) / 3;
502:         src = 'LG-exact-If/3-DERIVED';
503:     else
504:         i0 = NaN;
505:         src = 'MISSING-no-Iseq0-LLG-neutral-counted-once-N/A';
506:     end
507:     if isfinite(Mtrx.I_down_A(i)) && isfinite(Mtrx.ct_down(i))
508:         oLoc{end + 1} = ml{i}; oTyp{end + 1} = mt{i}; oCase{end + 1} = mc{i}; %#ok<AGROW>
509:         oDev{end + 1} = Mtrx.downstream{i}; oSide{end + 1} = 'downstream'; %#ok<AGROW>
510:         oIp(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_down_A(i) * Mtrx.ct_down(i); %#ok<AGROW>
511:         oIk(end + 1) = oIp(end) / 1000; %#ok<AGROW>
512:         oCt(end + 1) = Mtrx.ct_down(i); %#ok<AGROW>
513:         oIs(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_down_A(i); %#ok<AGROW>
514:         oI0(end + 1) = i0; %#ok<AGROW>
515:         oSrc{end + 1} = src; %#ok<AGROW>
516:         oProv{end + 1} = PROV; oScope{end + 1} = 'PRIMARY'; %#ok<AGROW>
517:     end
518:     if isfinite(Mtrx.I_up_A(i)) && isfinite(Mtrx.ct_up(i))
519:         oLoc{end + 1} = ml{i}; oTyp{end + 1} = mt{i}; oCase{end + 1} = mc{i}; %#ok<AGROW>
520:         oDev{end + 1} = Mtrx.upstream{i}; oSide{end + 1} = 'upstream'; %#ok<AGROW>
521:         oIp(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_up_A(i) * Mtrx.ct_up(i); %#ok<AGROW>
522:         oIk(end + 1) = oIp(end) / 1000; %#ok<AGROW>
523:         oCt(end + 1) = Mtrx.ct_up(i); %#ok<AGROW>
524:         oIs(end + 1) = Mtrx.I_up_A(i); %#ok<AGROW>
525:         oI0(end + 1) = i0; %#ok<AGROW>
526:         oSrc{end + 1} = src; %#ok<AGROW>
527:         oProv{end + 1} = PROV; oScope{end + 1} = 'PRIMARY'; %#ok<AGROW>
528:     end
529: end
530: Trc = table(oLoc', oTyp', oCase', oDev', oSide', oIp', oIk', oCt', ...
531:     oIs', oI0', oSrc', oProv', oScope', ...
532:     'VariableNames', {'fault_location', 'fault_type', 'caseID', ...
533:     'device_id', 'side', 'I_primary_A', 'I_primary_kA', 'CT_ratio', ...
534:     'I_secondary_A', 'I0_A', 'I0_source', 'provenance', 'scope'});
535: if height(Trc) < 1
536:     error('phase5b_production:rows', 'relay-currents table empty (matrix sides all missing).');
537: end
538: end

540: function Dduty = duty_provenance_split(Dduty12)
541: % DUTY_PROVENANCE_SPLIT  Stamp provenance/scope on the 12-col wrapper output.
542: %   Q0 rows (NOT DETERMINABLE interrupting): SOURCE-BACKED import basis.
543: %   52G rows (100 kA documented): SOURCE-BACKED rating basis.
544: %   NOTE row (ESTIMATED 50 kA station reference): ESTIMATED basis.
545: vn = Dduty12.Properties.VariableNames;
546: for k = 1:numel({'location', 'breaker_ref', 'fault_type', 'caseID', 'I_sym_kA', ...
547:         'I_peak_kA', 'rating_kA', 'basis', 'verdict', 'note', ...
548:         'equipment_rating_kA', 'equipment_basis'})
549:     need = {'location', 'breaker_ref', 'fault_type', 'caseID', 'I_sym_kA', ...
550:         'I_peak_kA', 'rating_kA', 'basis', 'verdict', 'note', ...
551:         'equipment_rating_kA', 'equipment_basis'};
552:     if ~any(strcmp(vn, need{k}))
553:         error('phase5b_production:schema', 'phase5b_duty output missing column %s.', need{k});
554:     end
555: end
556: n = height(Dduty12);
557: prov = cell(n, 1);
558: for i = 1:n
559:     br = Dduty12.breaker_ref{i};
560:     if isstring(br) && isscalar(br), br = char(br); end
561:     vd = Dduty12.verdict{i};
562:     if isstring(vd) && isscalar(vd), vd = char(vd); end
563:     if strcmp(strtrim(vd), 'NOTE')
564:         prov{i} = ['SOURCE-BACKED:Phase-4-production-import-joined-F3-LLL-total;' ...
565:             'ESTIMATED:50.00-kA-station-reference-informational-only-never-duty-basis'];
566:     elseif strcmp(strtrim(br), '52G')
567:         prov{i} = ['SOURCE-BACKED:Phase-4-production-import-through-current-branch-GEN_Q;' ...
568:             'SOURCE-BACKED:ledger-GCB-10BAC10-100kA-52G-interrupting-rating'];
569:     else
570:         prov{i} = 'SOURCE-BACKED:Phase-4-production-import-through-current-branch';
571:     end
572: end
573: Dduty = Dduty12;
574: Dduty.provenance = prov;
575: Dduty.scope = repmat({'PRIMARY'}, n, 1);
576: Dduty = Dduty(:, {'location', 'breaker_ref', 'fault_type', 'caseID', ...
577:     'I_sym_kA', 'I_peak_kA', 'rating_kA', 'basis', 'verdict', 'note', ...
578:     'equipment_rating_kA', 'equipment_basis', 'provenance', 'scope'});

581: function S = sensitivity_v2(T40, devicesProd, Rreg)
582: %SENSITIVITY_V2  v2-adapted GEN-scope sensitivity (C11 BLOCKED fallback).
583: %   The frozen PHASE5_SENSITIVITY is BLOCKED for v2 reuse (never modified):
584: %   it hard-codes the v1 2000 CT on its upstream GSUT leg
585: %   (phase5_sensitivity.m:137 'IsUp = pkUp / 2000', :190 'primUp / 2000',
586: %   :193 reason 'upstream-GSUT-HV-51-2000/1-untouched', comments :9/:11)
587: %   instead of reading device ct_ratio (1600 in v2). Evidence pinned in
588: %   test_phase5b_writer. This engine ports the frozen GEN-scope doctrine
589: %   exactly, reading every pickup/CT/TMS from the v2-resolved devices:
590: %     GEN-51 (phase, all 40 combos) + GEN-51N (earth, LG/LLG only, 20 rows)
591: %     = 60 rows; GEN dial fixed from the PRIMARY scheme via the device CT
592: %     (Is_fixed = P/ct_device, 15000); legacy secondaries via Rreg.ct_legacy
593: %     (16000 fence, read never hard-coded); upstream GSUT-HV-51 backup via
594: %     ITS device CT (1600 — the fix) with the v2-resolved pickup/TMS;
595: %     EF TMS 0.15 from the stamped devices (pickup-resolved, never registry
596: %     0.20). Frozen phase5_ct + phase5_time + phase5_ct_table(T40,16000)
597: %     audit reference only (legacy fence unchanged in v2).
598: %   Relay primaries mirror frozen branch parity: GEN-51 phase -> GEN_Q leg
599: %   else net total; GEN-51N F1/F2 -> 3xI0 neutral-once else LG-exact If/3
600: %   else NaN; GEN-51N F3/F4/F5 -> 3x leg_NER_earth delta block else NaN.
601: %   Verdict doctrine identical to frozen (CTI 0.3 s; NO-TRIP / NO-PAIR /
602: %   NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA). 28 locked cols, scope
603: %   SENSITIVITY, provenance LEGACY-tagged + v2-adaptation note.
604: d51 = finddev(devicesProd, 'GEN-51');
605: d51N = finddev(devicesProd, 'GEN-51N');
606: dUp = finddev(devicesProd, 'GSUT-HV-51');
607: ctGen = read_ct(d51, 'GEN-51');
608: ctLeg = double(Rreg.ct_legacy);
609: if ~(isscalar(ctLeg) && isfinite(ctLeg) && ctLeg > 0)
610:     error('phase5b_production:sensitivity', 'Rreg.ct_legacy must be finite > 0 (16000 fence, read never hard-coded).');
611: end
612: ctUp = read_ct(dUp, 'GSUT-HV-51');
613: pk51 = read_pickup(d51, 'GEN-51');
614: pkN = read_pickup(d51N, 'GEN-51N');
615: pkUp = read_pickup(dUp, 'GSUT-HV-51');
616: [tms51, cv51] = read_tc(d51, 'GEN-51');
617: [tmsN, cvN] = read_tc(d51N, 'GEN-51N');
618: [tmsUp, cvUp] = read_tc(dUp, 'GSUT-HV-51');
619: IsFix51 = pk51 / ctGen;
620: IsFixN = pkN / ctGen;
621: IsUp = pkUp / ctUp;
622: CTI = 0.3;
623: locs = tocell(T40.fault_location);
624: typs = tocell(T40.fault_type);
625: cases = tocell(T40.caseID);
626: n = height(T40);
627: If_A = double(T40.I_primary_A(:));
628: If_kA = double(T40.I_primary_kA(:));
629: if any(~isfinite(If_A)) || any(~isfinite(If_kA))
630:     error('phase5b_production:sensitivity', 'T40 fault currents must be finite.');
631: end
632: hasIseq0 = any(strcmp(T40.Properties.VariableNames, 'Iseq0_kA'));
633: if hasIseq0
634:     Iseq0_kA = double(T40.Iseq0_kA(:));
635: else
636:     Iseq0_kA = NaN(n, 1);
637: end
638: legGEN = legcol(T40, 'leg_GEN_kA', n);
639: legHV = legcol(T40, 'leg_GSUT_HV_kA', n);
640: legNER = legcol(T40, 'leg_NER_earth_kA', n);
641: Tleg = phase5_ct_table(T40, 16000, 'LEGACY-16000/1');
642: if height(Tleg) ~= n
643:     error('phase5b_production:sensitivity', 'legacy audit table row count diverged from T40.');
644: end
645: earthMask = strcmp(typs, 'LG') | strcmp(typs, 'LLG');
646: nEarth = sum(earthMask);
647: total = n + nEarth;
648: oLoc = cell(total, 1); oTyp = cell(total, 1); oCase = cell(total, 1);
649: oDev = cell(total, 1); oPath = cell(total, 1);
650: oIprim = NaN(total, 1); oIk = NaN(total, 1);
651: oIsecP = NaN(total, 1); oIsecS = NaN(total, 1);
652: oCtP = repmat(ctGen, total, 1); oCtL = repmat(ctLeg, total, 1);
653: oTag = repmat({'LEGACY-16000/1'}, total, 1);
654: oPk = NaN(total, 1); oTms = NaN(total, 1); oCv = cell(total, 1);
655: oTp = NaN(total, 1); oTs = NaN(total, 1); oDt = NaN(total, 1);
656: oDir = cell(total, 1);
657: oMgP = NaN(total, 1); oMgS = NaN(total, 1); oDmg = NaN(total, 1);
658: oMdir = cell(total, 1);
659: oVp = cell(total, 1); oVs = cell(total, 1);
660: oScope = repmat({'SENSITIVITY'}, total, 1);
661: oProv = repmat({['LEGACY:CT-16000/1-fenced-sensitivity-vs-PRIMARY-15000/1-GEN-v2-adapted-' ...
662:     'upstream-1600/1-device-CT-SOURCE-BACKED-Phase-4-import']}, total, 1);
663: oReason = cell(total, 1);
664: j = 0;
665: for i = 1:n
666:     loc = locs{i};
667:     typ = typs{i};
668:     cs = cases{i};
669:     isGenZone = strcmp(loc, 'F1') || strcmp(loc, 'F2');
670:     if isfinite(legGEN(i)) && legGEN(i) >= 0
671:         prim51 = legGEN(i) * 1000;
672:         path51 = 'GEN_Q-branch-leg_GEN_kA-SOURCE-BACKED';
673:     else
674:         prim51 = If_A(i);
675:         path51 = 'net-total-fallback-no-leg-join';
676:     end
677:     secP51 = phase5_ct(prim51, ctGen).Isec_A;
678:     secS51 = phase5_ct(prim51, ctLeg).Isec_A;
679:     tP51 = sidetime(secP51, IsFix51, tms51, cv51);
680:     tS51 = sidetime(secS51, IsFix51, tms51, cv51);
681:     if isGenZone
682:         if isfinite(legHV(i)) && legHV(i) >= 0
683:             primUp = legHV(i) * 1000;
684:             upTag = 'GSUT_HV-branch-leg_GSUT_HV_kA-SOURCE-BACKED';
685:         else
686:             primUp = If_A(i);
687:             upTag = 'net-total-fallback-no-leg-join';
688:         end
689:         tUp = sidetime(primUp / ctUp, IsUp, tmsUp, cvUp);
690:         [mgP, vP] = pairverdict(tP51, tUp, CTI);
691:         [mgS, vS] = pairverdict(tS51, tUp, CTI);
692:         mgNote = sprintf([';upstream-GSUT-HV-51-v2-device-CT-%.0f/1(t_up=%.3fs;%s);' ...
693:             'CTI-0.3s-study-threshold'], ctUp, tUp, upTag);
694:     else
695:         tUp = NaN;
696:         [mgP, vP] = nopairverdict(tP51);
697:         [mgS, vS] = nopairverdict(tS51);
698:         mgNote = [';NO-PAIR (topology): GEN backup not in grid-zone chain;' ...
699:             'backup-t_down-reported-no-margin-asserted'];
700:     end
701:     [dt51, dir51] = classdir(tP51, tS51);
702:     [dmg51, mdir51] = classmargin(mgP, mgS);
703:     j = j + 1;
704:     oLoc{j} = loc; oTyp{j} = typ; oCase{j} = cs; oDev{j} = 'GEN-51';
705:     oPath{j} = path51; oIprim(j) = prim51; oIk(j) = prim51 / 1000;
706:     oIsecP(j) = secP51; oIsecS(j) = secS51;
707:     oPk(j) = pk51; oTms(j) = tms51; oCv{j} = cv51;
708:     oTp(j) = tP51; oTs(j) = tS51; oDt(j) = dt51; oDir{j} = dir51;
709:     oMgP(j) = mgP; oMgS(j) = mgS; oDmg(j) = dmg51; oMdir{j} = mdir51;
710:     oVp{j} = vP; oVs{j} = vS;
711:     oReason{j} = sprintf(['GEN-51 %s %s %s: relay-primary %.6g A (%s);' ...
712:         'pickup %.2f A-primary dial-fixed %.6g A-sec via device CT %.0f/1;' ...
713:         'TMS %.3g %s;t_prim %.3fs t_sens %.3fs dt %.3fs (%s)%s;' ...
714:         'LEGACY-16000/1 fenced vs PRIMARY-15000/1 GEN (v2-adapted upstream %.0f/1)'], ...
715:         loc, typ, cs, prim51, path51, pk51, IsFix51, ctGen, ...
716:         tms51, cv51, tP51, tS51, dt51, dir51, mgNote, ctUp);
717:     if strcmp(typ, 'LG') || strcmp(typ, 'LLG')
718:         if isGenZone
719:             if isfinite(Iseq0_kA(i))
720:                 primN = 3 * Iseq0_kA(i) * 1000;
721:                 pathN = '3I0-fault-total-Iseq0-SOURCE-BACKED-neutral-counted-once';
722:                 missN = false;
723:             elseif strcmp(typ, 'LG')
724:                 primN = If_A(i);
725:                 pathN = '3I0-LG-exact-If-over-3-DERIVED-neutral-counted-once';
726:                 missN = false;
727:             else
728:                 primN = NaN;
729:                 pathN = 'MISSING-no-Iseq0-LLG-neutral-counted-once-N/A';
730:                 missN = true;
731:             end
732:         else
733:             if isfinite(legNER(i)) && legNER(i) >= 0
734:                 primN = 3 * legNER(i) * 1000;
735:                 pathN = '3xleg_NER_earth-delta-block-neutral-counted-once';
736:                 missN = false;
737:             else
738:                 primN = NaN;
739:                 pathN = '3xleg_NER_earth-MISSING-neutral-counted-once-N/A';
740:                 missN = true;
741:             end
742:         end
743:         if isfinite(primN) && primN >= 0
744:             secPN = phase5_ct(primN, ctGen).Isec_A;
745:             secSN = phase5_ct(primN, ctLeg).Isec_A;
746:             tPN = sidetime(secPN, IsFixN, tmsN, cvN);
747:             tSN = sidetime(secSN, IsFixN, tmsN, cvN);
748:         else
749:             secPN = NaN;
750:             secSN = NaN;
751:             tPN = NaN;
752:             tSN = NaN;
753:         end
754:         [vPN, vSN, eNote] = earthverdicts(tPN, tSN, missN, isGenZone, loc, typ, cs);
755:         [dtN, dirN] = classdir(tPN, tSN);
756:         j = j + 1;
757:         oLoc{j} = loc; oTyp{j} = typ; oCase{j} = cs; oDev{j} = 'GEN-51N';
758:         oPath{j} = pathN; oIprim(j) = primN; oIk(j) = primN / 1000;
759:         oIsecP(j) = secPN; oIsecS(j) = secSN;
760:         oPk(j) = pkN; oTms(j) = tmsN; oCv{j} = cvN;
761:         oTp(j) = tPN; oTs(j) = tSN; oDt(j) = dtN; oDir{j} = dirN;
762:         oMgP(j) = NaN; oMgS(j) = NaN; oDmg(j) = NaN; oMdir{j} = 'N/A';
763:         oVp{j} = vPN; oVs{j} = vSN;
764:         oReason{j} = sprintf(['GEN-51N %s %s %s: relay-primary %.6g A (%s);' ...
765:             'pickup %.2f A-primary dial-fixed %.6g A-sec via device CT %.0f/1;' ...
766:             'TMS %.3g %s (EF pickup-resolved);t_prim %.3fs t_sens %.3fs dt %.3fs (%s);%s;' ...
767:             'LEGACY-16000/1 fenced vs PRIMARY-15000/1 GEN'], ...
768:             loc, typ, cs, primN, pathN, pkN, IsFixN, ctGen, ...
769:             tmsN, cvN, tPN, tSN, dtN, dirN, eNote);
770:     end
771: end
772: S = table(oLoc, oTyp, oCase, oDev, oIprim, oIk, oPath, oIsecP, oIsecS, ...
773:     oCtP, oCtL, oTag, oPk, oTms, oCv, oTp, oTs, oDt, oDir, ...
774:     oMgP, oMgS, oDmg, oMdir, oVp, oVs, oScope, oProv, oReason, ...
775:     'VariableNames', {'fault_location', 'fault_type', 'caseID', 'device_id', ...
776:     'I_primary_A', 'I_primary_kA', 'relay_path', 'I_sec_primary_A', ...
777:     'I_sec_sens_A', 'ct_primary', 'ct_legacy', 'ct_tag', 'pickup_primary_A', ...
778:     'tms', 'curve', 't_primary_s', 't_sens_s', 'dt_s', 'direction', ...
779:     'margin_primary_s', 'margin_sens_s', 'dmargin_s', 'margin_direction', ...
780:     'verdict_primary', 'verdict_sens', 'scope', 'provenance', 'reason'});

783: function d = finddev(devices, id)
784: d = [];
785: for k = 1:numel(devices)
786:     did = devices(k).device_id;
787:     if isstring(did) && isscalar(did), did = char(did); end
788:     if ischar(did) && strcmp(strtrim(did), id), d = devices(k); return; end
789: end
790: error('phase5b_production:devices', 'device %s not found in v2 devices.', id);
791: end
792: 
793: function ct = read_ct(d, id)
794: ct = double(d.ct_ratio);
795: if ~(isscalar(ct) && isfinite(ct) && ct > 0)
796:     error('phase5b_production:sensitivity', 'device %s needs finite ct_ratio > 0 (v2 device CT, read never hard-coded).', id);
797: end
798: end
799: 
800: function pk = read_pickup(d, id)
801: pk = double(d.pickup_A);
802: if ~(isscalar(pk) && isfinite(pk) && pk > 0)
803:     error('phase5b_production:sensitivity', 'device %s needs finite stamped pickup_A > 0 (C4-resolved, read never hard-coded).', id);
804: end
805: end
806: 
807: function [tms, cv] = read_tc(d, id)
808: tm = double(d.tms);
809: if ~(isscalar(tm) && isfinite(tm) && tm > 0)
810:     error('phase5b_production:sensitivity', 'device %s needs finite stamped tms > 0 (C4-resolved, read never hard-coded).', id);
811: end
812: tms = tm;
813: cv = d.curve;
814: if isstring(cv) && isscalar(cv), cv = char(cv); end
815: if ischar(cv) && ~isempty(strtrim(cv))
816:     cv = upper(strtrim(cv));
817: else
818:     cv = 'SI';
819: end
820: end
821: 
822: function t = sidetime(Isec, IsSec, tms, cv)
823: if ~isscalar(Isec) || ~isreal(Isec) || ~isfinite(Isec) || Isec < 0
824:     t = NaN;
825:     return;
826: end
827: t = phase5_time(Isec, IsSec, tms, cv);
828: end

830: function [mg, vd] = pairverdict(tDown, tUp, CTI)
831: if ~isfinite(tDown) || ~isfinite(tUp)
832:     mg = NaN;
833:     vd = 'NO-TRIP';
834:     return;
835: end
836: mg = tUp - tDown;
837: if mg >= CTI
838:     vd = 'PASS';
839: else
840:     vd = 'FAIL';
841: end
842: end
843: 
844: function [mg, vd] = nopairverdict(tDown)
845: mg = NaN;
846: if ~isfinite(tDown)
847:     vd = 'NO-TRIP';
848: else
849:     vd = 'NO-PAIR';
850: end
851: end

853: function [vP, vS, note] = earthverdicts(tP, tS, missN, isGenZone, loc, typ, cs)
854: if missN
855:     if isGenZone
856:         vP = 'NO-TRIP';
857:         vS = 'NO-TRIP';

4: %   min-detect with one struct row per (device, element in

6: %   over zone-relevant faults, the C4 study pickup (via phase5b_pickup),
7: %   the margin (min_branch_A / pickup_A) and a verdict:
8: %     margin >= 1               -> 'DETECT'
9: %     margin <  1 (determinable) -> 'BLIND-SPOT-HONEST' (non-PASS, never tuned)
10: %     not determinable           -> 'NOT-DETERMINABLE' (honest, never invented)
11: %
12: %   Row fields (locked): device_id, element, zone_locs, branch_tag,
13: %   n_zone, n_used, min_branch_A, min_loc, min_type, min_case, pickup_A,
14: %   pickup_src, margin, verdict, determinable, reason.

16: %   Zone relevance (locked): GEN devices <- F1/F2 rows (GEN_Q branch leg
17: %   for phase; 3I0 = 3x NER series leg for residual; negseq branch NOT
18: %   DETERMINABLE); GSUT-HV <- F1/F2/F3 rows (GSUT_HV leg); GIS-Q0 <-
19: %   F3/F4/F5 rows (LINE_Q9 through-convention magnitude: |leg_LINE_total|
20: %   for non-F4 rows; F4 rows use the same column with the documented
21: %   caveat that toward-fault B1+B2 sums both infeeds, so the F4 value
22: %   overstates the GIS outfeed — the GIS min binds at F5 regardless).
23: %
24: %   Branch-current doctrine (hardened): ONLY leg_* columns of the
25: %   phase5_import T40 join are read (C5-pinned branch-through-current
26: %   semantics). Fault totals are never a proxy for relay current: no
27: %   fault-point magnitude column is referenced anywhere below.
28: %
29: %   Stored production legs are |Ia| magnitudes only (phase4_handoff
30: %   legRow). Phase-element candidate types are therefore LLL (symmetric:
31: %   all phases equal |Ia|) and LG (A-phase faulted; B/C ~ 0 per the
32: %   phase4 LG_branch0 diagnostic): on LL/LLG rows the stored |Ia| is the
33: %   UNFAULTED-phase current and understates what B/C phase elements see,
34: %   so LL/LLG phase coverage is recorded NOT-DETERMINABLE-by-type

2: %PHASE5B_ID_ALIASES  Canonical study-ID resolution (Phase-5b Task C7).

8: %   other registry device_id resolve to themselves (idempotent). The map is
9: %   also recorded as a comment block inside phase5b_registry.m (same table).
10: %   Pickup equality both directions is asserted in test_phase5b_zones

parts.text: Compiling file inventories and extracting exact registry values with file:line references from source.
Pinpointing a stale function call in the production script and confirming GEN-51N scope as sensitivity.

Read-only inventory — no files modified.

### 1. `matlab/phase5/*.m` — 37 files

**v2 `phase5b_*` (16) + runners (2):**

| File | Purpose `file:line` |
|---|---|
| `phase5b_registry.m:2` | Device registry v2 study rows + physical presence rows (Tasks C2+C7), 33 rows, 26 fields |
| `phase5b_pickup.m:2` | Pickup engine v2: Siemens DT baseline + study rules (C3/C4) |
| `phase5b_effectiveness.m:2` | Primary/backup effectiveness table, review S15 (C8), 48 rows |
| `phase5b_duty.m:2` | Breaker-duty correction: 52G rows + equipment/interrupting split (C9) |
| `phase5b_validate.m:2` | v2 validation legs B01-B13 + R0 re-import identity (C12) |
| `phase5b_sensitivity_v2.m:2` | v2-adapted GEN-scope sensitivity, testable module (C11 fix 1/4) |
| `phase5b_tcc.m:2` | Two-class TCC plots: physical DT vs study SI (C10) |
| `phase5b_writer.m:2` | v2 CSV/manifest/sha256/run_log writer, 10 tables (C11) |
| `phase5b_ct_scope.m:2` | Legacy-16000/1 sensitivity scope helper, gen-only (C2) |
| `phase5b_sensitivity_scope.m:2` | Plan-name alias forwarding to `phase5b_ct_scope` (C2) |
| `phase5b_id_aliases.m:2` | Canonical study-ID resolution `GEN-51-SI→GEN-51`, `GEN-51N-SI-STUDY→GEN-51N` (C7) |
| `phase5b_zones.m:2` | Protection-zone / primary-mapping table G/T/B/L (C7) |
| `phase5b_mindetect.m:2` | Per-CT min-detect over zone-relevant branch currents (C6) |
| `phase5b_branch_phasors.m:2` | Identity-gated branch-phasor recompute for LL/LLG B/C (C6b) |
| `phase5b_source_ledger.m:2` | Transcribed protection-source table (C1) |
| `phase5b_gate.m:2` | Phase-5b extended quality-gate, 23 predicates P01-17+B01-06 (C14) |
| `run_phase5b_production.m:2` | End-to-end Phase-5b production-v2 driver (C11) |
| `run_phase5b_tests.m:2` | Phase-5b test runner `test_phase5b_*.m` + `phase5b_validate` (C12) |

**Frozen v1 (19+2 runners):**

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `phase5_registry.m:2` | Device registry + topology + CT ledger (Task 2) |

### 2. `matlab/tests/test_phase5*.m` / `test_phase5b*.m` — 29 files

**v1 `test_phase5_*.m` (14):** `test_phase5_writer, _time, _tcc, _sensitivity, _registry, _pickup, _matrix, _instantaneous, _import, _gate, _duty, _curve, _ct, _coord`

**v2 `test_phase5b_*.m` (15):** `test_phase5b_zones, _writer, _validate, _tcc, _sensitivity_v2, _report, _registry, _pickup, _mindetect, _ledger, _gate, _effectiveness, _duty, _branch_phasors, _branch_audit`

All under `matlab/tests/`.

### 3. Current registry values — `matlab/phase5/phase5b_registry.m`

STUDY rows carry `pickup_A=NaN`, `tms=0.20`, rule recomputed in C4:

* `GEN-51` STUDY: `ct_ratio 15000:66`, `pickup NaN:71`, `tms 0.20:72`, `ct_source SOURCE-BACKED:67`, `layer STUDY:86`. C4 computed `1.20*14309=17170.8A SI TMS 0.20 PRIMARY` — `phase5b_pickup.m:87,129,151-155`.
* `GSUT-HV-51` STUDY: `ct 1600:120`, `pickup NaN:125`, `tms 0.20:126`, `SOURCE-BACKED:121`. C4 computed `1.2*max(1150,Iload)=1380A SI TMS 0.20 PRIMARY` — `phase5b_pickup.m:175,194-198`.
* `GIS-Q0-51` STUDY: `ct 1600:146-148`, `pickup NaN:151`, `tms 0.20:152`, `breaker_ref Q0:157`. C4 computed `1.2*Iload (LINE_Q9 869.9567A → 1043.9479A) SI TMS 0.20 PRIMARY` — `phase5b_pickup.m:213,226-230`.
* `GEN-51N` STUDY: `ct 15000:93`, `pickup NaN:98`, `tms 0.20:99`, `ef NaN:101-102`, `assumption PRIMARY:108`, `layer STUDY:113`. C4 computed `5A SI EF-TMS 0.15 SENSITIVITY` — `phase5b_pickup.m:97,109-113` (see §5).
* `GEN-51-SIEMENS-BL` PHYSICAL: `ct 15000:263`, `pickup 17171:268`, `tms NaN:269`, `curve DT-??:270`, `USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC:276` — `phase5b_pickup.m:234-266` (`tdef 3.0s, use_phase5_time false`).
* `GEN-87G` PHYSICAL diff: `ct 15000:290`, `pickup 0.20*12019=2403.8:295`, `tms NaN:296` — `phase5b_registry.m:285-310`.
* `GSUT-87T` PHYSICAL diff: `ct 1600:641`, `pickup NaN:646`, `tms NaN:647`, presence-only `7UT6331 settings-MISSING:654,659` — `:635-661`.
* `GIS-87B` PHYSICAL diff: `ct 1600:776`, `pickup NaN:781`, `tms NaN:782`, presence-only `7SS523 settings-MISSING:789,794` — `:771-796`.
* `GIS-50BF` PHYSICAL bf: `ct 1600:803`, `pickup NaN:808`, `tms NaN:809`, `breaker_ref '':813`, `BF-path-NOT-DETERMINABLE:816,821` — `:798-823`.
* `GEN-52G` breaker: no pickup; `rated 12400:886`, `provenance GCB-10BAC10-100kA:897` — `:879-904`.

### 4. Bug confirmed — YES

`matlab/phase5/run_phase5b_production.m:189`:
```
[NP, NF] = run_phase5_tests();
```
Calls frozen **v1** runner, not `run_phase5b_tests()` (which exists at `matlab/phase5/run_phase5b_tests.m:1-13`). Header `:64-68` also documents `run_phase5_tests()`. Same stale ref in `phase5b_writer.m:68,239,271,345` (`runner run_phase5_tests`).

### 5. GEN-51N 5A scope — SENSITIVITY (not PRIMARY)

* Engine: `phase5b_pickup.m:90` comment `scope SENSITIVITY`; `:97 IS=5`; `:100 basis ...scope-SENSITIVITY-EF-TMS-0.15-study`; `:101-103 source ...scope-SENSITIVITY`; `:109-113 assumption_class SENSITIVITY, tms/ef_tms 0.15, SI, use_phase5_time true`.
* Registry row itself stays `assumption_class PRIMARY:108`, `tms 0.20:99`, `layer STUDY:113` — EF 0.15 comes from pickup, asserted in `run_phase5b_production.m:331-336`.
* `phase5b_ct_scope.m:20-21` returns true for `GEN-51N` (gen-only 16k fence); `phase5b_sensitivity_scope.m:2-10` forwards identically.

> equipment. TCCs are split into PHYSICAL/SOURCE-BACKED vs GENERIC STUDY classes. All relay data are **study
> settings** evaluated in a **qualified model**. The peak current `ip` is a borrowed-shape design-defined quantity
> (informational only, never a breaker-duty input).

---

## 1. Executive summary

Phase-5b applies a physical protection architecture plus a qualified backup-OC/EF coordination study to the
frozen Phase-4 production fault package for Ashuganj South, covering 2 cases (`LF360_GAT_OUT`,
`LF360_GAT_IN`) x 5 fault locations (F1–F5) x 4 fault types (LLL/LG/LL/LLG) = 40 backbone rows.

Headline v2 results (each reproduced from the shipped `results/phase5_protection_v2/` CSVs, read with
`readtable(fp, 'Delimiter', ',')`):

- Study pickups (v2, as found): GEN-51-SI **17170.8 A** primary (1.20xImax 14309 A), GEN-51N-SI-STUDY **5 A**
  primary (SENSITIVE retained case), GSUT-HV-51 **1380 A** primary via 1600/1, GIS-Q0-51 **1043.94798235109 A**
  primary via 1600/1 (`phase5_relay_settings.csv`, 8 rows). Separate PHYSICAL baseline GEN-51-SIEMENS-BL
  **17171 A** primary (1.1447 A secondary via 15000/1, DT-??, tdef 3.00 s ?? PENDING-COORDINATION,
  USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC, inverse prohibited — never dispatched to `phase5_time`).
- Coordination matrix v2 (96 rows, as found): **FAIL = 20, NO-TRIP = 28, NO-PAIR = 24,
  NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA = 24, PASS = 0 (production-v2, 96 rows)**. Identical counts appear in
  `phase5_coordination_margins.csv`. No margin was tuned; shortfalls are study-setting coordination shortfalls
  reported honestly (see Sections 9 and 17).
- Breaker duty v2 (81 rows, as found): **40 x Q0 NOT DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA + 40 x 52G PASS +
  1 x Q0 NOTE**. That is 40 Q0 rows with no interrupting rating sourced, 40 52G rows PASS vs the sourced
  52G/GCB-10BAC10 100 kA sym breaking rating, plus one informational NOTE (F3 LLL 50.530885 kA +1.06% vs the
  estimated 50 kA station reference). Equipment withstand (GIS 50 kA) lives only in equipment columns, never as
  an interrupting rating.
- Effectiveness v2 (`phase5b_effectiveness.csv`, 48 rows = 40 backbone + 8 Siemens-baseline F1 duplicates, as
  found): **ASSERTABLE-DETECT = 24, NOT-DETERMINABLE = 24**. F1/F2 primaries assertable (87G/87T); F3/F4/F5
  primaries NOT-DETERMINABLE (87B/7SD settings missing; F5 out-of-zone). Primary timing 0.045 s derived
  fast-main clearing applies only to F1/87G + 52G identified; all other primary times NaN with reasons (see
  Section 16).
- Low-earth-fault physics preserved: F1 LG **7.272 A** primary -> **0.4848 mA** secondary through
  15000/1, covered by the 5 A sensitive EF study pickup with margin **1.454**; branch-through-current
  F1 LG GEN_Q **8.4141 kA** pinned by audit (never a bus total).
- Sensitivity (60 rows, all scope SENSITIVITY): 16000/1 recomputation fenced to generator-CT scope only.
  Validation **16/16** frozen-framework legs; suite **355 passed / 0 failed** at the v2 stamp (v1 suite 344/0 is
  frozen in the §20 v1 appendix).

## 2. Scope and freeze boundary (S1 reclassification)

In scope (v2): physical protection architecture (device presence rows, zones G/T/B/L, 52G breaker, CT cores),
CT conversion via sourced ratios, inverse-time library on study rows only, pickup methodology per master §21
rule (1.20x maximum load), operating-time calculation on study SI rows via frozen `phase5_time`,
coordination matrix + margins on backup-OC pairs, two-class TCC figures (physical DT vs study SI),
breaker-duty engine with rating split (interrupting vs equipment withstand), fenced sensitivity,
provenance ledger incl. USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC, 16-leg frozen validation + B-legs, writer +
production-v2 driver, effectiveness table, this report, quality gate.

Out of scope (explicitly excluded): stability/AVR/SFC studies, relay vendor selection,
field-test procedures, equipment procurement ratings, any revision of Phase-3 or Phase-4 results. No claim is
made that every installed function was simulated; functions without sourced thresholds appear as presence rows
with MISSING settings.

Freeze boundary: `matlab/data/*`, `matlab/build/*`, `rev2/*`, `matlab/phase4/*`, `PHASE3_*`,
`results/phase4_fault/*`, and `results/phase5_protection/*` were read-only inputs. Phase-5b adds new
`phase5b_*` modules alongside frozen v1 files and writes the new tag production-v2 under
`results/phase5_protection_v2/`. The regression leg (R0) proves import identity before any output: F3 LLL OUT
= 50.5308851865359 kA (tolerance 1e-6) and F1 LG OUT = 0.00727200442799167 kA (tolerance 1e-9).

## 3. Input fault matrix (2 x 5 x 4 backbone)

`phase5_fault_inputs.csv` (40 rows) is the backbone import: stage `Ikpp`, `m = 0.5`, first row per
(caseID, location, fault_type) in backbone-first merge order — SOURCE-BACKED Phase-4 import
(`phase5_import`). F1 and F2 share one node but are kept as **distinct labelled rows with identical
values** (no artificial impedance invented); F4 primary rows carry `m = 0.5`. Fault types
LLL/LG/LL/LLG are all present for every (case, location) pair; the primary cases are
`LF360_GAT_OUT` (base) and `LF360_GAT_IN` (GAT-IN leg), never double-counted (manifest backbone:

## 4. Device registry, topology and CT ledger (v2, 33 rows)

## 5. CT secondary conversion

`phase5_ct`: pure arithmetic `Isec_A = I_primary_A / ct_ratio`; the ledger fencing lives in
`ct_tag`/scope/provenance, never in the arithmetic. v2 CTs are 15000/1 (GEN, SOURCE-BACKED) and 1600/1
(GSUT/GIS, SOURCE-BACKED). Spot conversions:

- 12019 A -> 0.8012667 A secondary (via 15000/1).
- F1 LG 7.27200442799167 A -> **0.0004848 A (0.4848 mA)** secondary (sensitive-EF regime; the
  low-earth-fault physics survives CT conversion).
- F1 LLL GEN branch 55048.71 A -> 3.66991398 A secondary (via 15000/1); GSUT_HV branch 72105.15 A ->
  45.06572141 A secondary (via 1600/1).
- GEN-51-SI 17170.8 A -> 1.14472 A secondary; GEN-51-SIEMENS-BL 17171 A -> 1.1447 A secondary
  (cross-check 1.20x14309 = 17170.8 ≈ 17171, rel-err 0.000012); GSUT-HV-51 1380 A -> 0.8625 A;
  GIS-Q0-51 1043.94798235109 A -> 0.652467 A.

`phase5_relay_currents.csv` (108 rows) distinguishes phase-branch current (`I_primary_A`),
zero-sequence current (`I0_A` with `I0_source`) and secondary current (`I_secondary_A`) on every
row. Neutral impedance is counted exactly once: GEN-51N F1 LG relay current 7.27200443 A equals
3 x I0 (I0 = 0.00242400147600 kA), never 9 x I0. Branch currents are branch-through-current legs
(GEN_Q / GSUT_HV / GRID_Q / LINE B1/B2); bus totals never proxy relay current (the 43758.86 A-style totals
appear nowhere in detection logic).

## 6. Curve library (study constants + physical DT separation)

`phase5_curve` centralises the inverse-time formulation `t = TMS x k / ((I/Is)^alpha - 1)`
(`M = I/Is`; `M <= 1` -> `Inf`, i.e. no trip), plus definite-time/instantaneous routing
(`phase5_curve_dt`; default path has no `Iinst`, so nothing trips instantaneously by accident).
Study constants, single-sourced in `phase5_curve_info` and labelled STUDY: SI k = 0.14 / alpha = 0.02;
VI k = 13.5 / alpha = 1.0; EI k = 80 / alpha = 2.0. Production-v2 uses the SI family on study rows with
TMS **0.20 phase / 0.15 EF** (master §21 Status-C initial values; CTI 0.3 s is SOURCE-BACKED confirmed via
ledger CTI-0.3s, not an assumption). The PHYSICAL DT baseline row carries `curve = DT-??` with a
`use_phase5_time = false` flag: `phase5_time` refuses it (inverse prohibited), so no inverse time is ever
computed for the 3.00 s ?? definite-time value.

## 17. Limitations (read before using any number)

1. **52-1 bay-position assumption.** Mapping Q0 onto the 52-1 plant-outlet breaker is an
   engineering assumption carried in every duty basis string; if the single-line bay assignment
   differs, the through-current path selection must be re-done.
2. **GEN-51-SI unbalanced-branch blindness.** For unbalanced generator-zone faults the GEN_Q branch
   current sits below the 17170.8 A study pickup (F1 LG 8414.12 A; F1 LL 8322.14 A;
   F1 LLG 8321.45 A), so GEN-51-SI returns NO-TRIP on unbalanced generator-zone rows
   while upstream devices still see fault current. Phase-fault backing for unbalanced faults is
   therefore not demonstrated by this study layer (the 87G main above is the assertable cover).
3. **EF thin margin (2.272 A).** GEN-51N-SI-STUDY 5 A detects the 7.27 A F1 LG fault with 2.272 A absolute
   margin (1.454 ratio) at ~2.79 s through a 0.33–0.48 mA secondary path. This is sensitive by
   construction and susceptible to noise, CT error and NER-parameter drift; it is a finding to be
   hardened with measured data, not a field recommendation.
4. **LLG earth fallbacks.** LLG earth pairs have no residual CT in the registry upstream, so they
   resolve as NOT DETERMINABLE or NO-TRIP where GEN-51N sees only 3.63 A < 5 A pickup. Earth backup
   coordination is therefore not demonstrated for LLG faults beyond the LG-basis scope note.
5. **No PASS in the backup-OC coordination matrix.** Under study TMS values and the confirmed 0.3 s CTI,
   zero of 96 backup-OC pairs pass; 20 FAIL honestly (including negative margins where the
   upstream element is faster). Nothing was re-tuned to manufacture passes.
6. **Q0 has no duty verdict.** Without a sourced Q0 interrupting rating, all 40 Q0 duty rows
   are NOT DETERMINABLE; the +1.06% 50-kA comparison is context, not acceptance. 52G verdicts are PASS only
   against the sourced 100 kA interrupting rating.
7. **Peak currents are borrowed-shape design-defined.** `I_peak_kA` is informational only and never
   enters duty, margin or time arithmetic.
8. **TCC figures are illustrations under CSV governance.** Machine-readable CSVs govern in any conflict.
9. **Study CT/TMS/SI assumptions labelled.** 1600/1 study CTs carry bay-dependence flags, TMS 0.20/0.15 are
   Status-C initial values, and the SI family is a study choice; changing any of them moves times and margins.
10. **USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC limits.** Four value groups (I> 1.14 A / 17171 A, tdef 3.00 s ??, 87G 0.20/5.0,
    64G 20-Hz) are user-supplied pending document ingest; the ?? timing stays NOT DETERMINABLE until
    coordination detail arrives.

# 11. LINE-ASSUMPTION BASIS

The assumptions are deliberately non-zero and are constrained by published examples.

- A 400-kV benchmark line has typical values near **R1 = 0.0209 ohm/km, X1 = 0.3192 ohm/km, B1 = 5.19 uS/km; R0 = 0.303 ohm/km, X0 = 1.189 ohm/km, B0 = 3.17 uS/km**. Our 400-kV Twin-Finch values are chosen close to this range while reflecting the actual high-capacity bundle. (OPAL-RT typical 400-kV benchmark.)
- A published 230-kV overhead-line example gives approximately **Z1 = 0.060 + j0.472 ohm/km** and **Z0 = 0.230 + j1.590 ohm/km**. (SEL technical paper.)
- Conductor references give approximately **0.0509 ohm/km at 20 C for Finch 1113 MCM** and approximately **0.0715-0.0719 ohm/km at 20 C for Mallard 795 MCM**. Published Grosbeak 636 data are around **0.0899 ohm/km at 20 C for ACSR**. These support the resistance scale used above.

**Engineering rule:** if a PGCB line-parameter report is later obtained, replace all C-values immediately and retain the current values only for preliminary/sensitivity analysis.

## 1. Executive summary

Phase-5b applies a physical protection architecture plus a qualified backup-OC/EF coordination study to the
frozen Phase-4 production fault package for Ashuganj South, covering 2 cases (`LF360_GAT_OUT`,
`LF360_GAT_IN`) x 5 fault locations (F1–F5) x 4 fault types (LLL/LG/LL/LLG) = 40 backbone rows.

`readtable(fp, 'Delimiter', ',')`):

  primary (SENSITIVE retained case), GSUT-HV-51 **1380 A** primary via 1600/1, GIS-Q0-51 **1043.94798235109 A**

- Coordination matrix v2 (96 rows, as found): **FAIL = 20, NO-TRIP = 28, NO-PAIR = 24,

  reported honestly (see Sections 9 and 17).

  52G/GCB-10BAC10 100 kA sym breaking rating, plus one informational NOTE (F3 LLL 50.530885 kA +1.06% vs the
  estimated 50 kA station reference). Equipment withstand (GIS 50 kA) lives only in equipment columns, never as
  an interrupting rating.
- Effectiveness v2 (`phase5b_effectiveness.csv`, 48 rows = 40 backbone + 8 Siemens-baseline F1 duplicates, as
  found): **ASSERTABLE-DETECT = 24, NOT-DETERMINABLE = 24**. F1/F2 primaries assertable (87G/87T); F3/F4/F5
  primaries NOT-DETERMINABLE (87B/7SD settings missing; F5 out-of-zone). Primary timing 0.045 s derived
  fast-main clearing applies only to F1/87G + 52G identified; all other primary times NaN with reasons (see
  Section 16).
- Low-earth-fault physics preserved: F1 LG **7.272 A** primary -> **0.4848 mA** secondary through
  15000/1, covered by the 5 A sensitive EF study pickup with margin **1.454**; branch-through-current
  F1 LG GEN_Q **8.4141 kA** pinned by audit (never a bus total).

  frozen in the §20 v1 appendix).

breaker-duty engine with rating split (interrupting vs equipment withstand), fenced sensitivity,

## 6. Curve library (study constants + physical DT separation)

`phase5_curve` centralises the inverse-time formulation `t = TMS x k / ((I/Is)^alpha - 1)`
(`M = I/Is`; `M <= 1` -> `Inf`, i.e. no trip), plus definite-time/instantaneous routing
(`phase5_curve_dt`; default path has no `Iinst`, so nothing trips instantaneously by accident).
Study constants, single-sourced in `phase5_curve_info` and labelled STUDY: SI k = 0.14 / alpha = 0.02;
VI k = 13.5 / alpha = 1.0; EI k = 80 / alpha = 2.0. Production-v2 uses the SI family on study rows with
TMS **0.20 phase / 0.15 EF** (master §21 Status-C initial values; CTI 0.3 s is SOURCE-BACKED confirmed via
ledger CTI-0.3s, not an assumption). The PHYSICAL DT baseline row carries `curve = DT-??` with a
`use_phase5_time = false` flag: `phase5_time` refuses it (inverse prohibited), so no inverse time is ever
computed for the 3.00 s ?? definite-time value.

## 9. Coordination matrix and margins (v2, as found)

`phase5_coordination_matrix.csv` + `phase5_coordination_margins.csv` (96 rows each). Hierarchy is

## 11. Breaker duty and the 50-kA comparison (v2, 81 rows)

`phase5_breaker_duty.csv` (81 rows) is produced by the duty engine **separate from coordination**,
using symmetrical RMS **through-current** from branch legs — never bus totals. New v2 columns separate

interrupting rating) from `rating_kA` (breaker interrupting rating; 52G 100 kA SOURCE-BACKED, Q0 NaN MISSING).

Q51/Q52/Q8 earthing never appear as duty rows.

  (`rating_kA` NaN), so no PASS/FAIL is asserted. Through-currents still reported SOURCE-BACKED (e.g. F1 LLL
  OUT grid-infeed 72.11 kA; F1 LLL IN 74.43 kA; F3 LLL OUT plant-infeed 3.218 kA; F5 LLL OUT 3.208 kA).

  (SOURCE-BACKED REV3 ledger GCB-10BAC10-100kA). GEN_Q branch vs 100 kA — DETERMINABLE (e.g. F1 LLL OUT
  55.05 kA PASS; F1 LG 8.414 kA PASS; F1 LL 8.322 kA PASS; max 52G duty 55.05 kA on F1/F2 LLL OUT).

  reference: **+1.06%** (`ESTIMATED:50.00-kA-station-reference-informational-only-never-duty-basis` with
  equipment_short_circuit_rating 50 kA withstand as context). Informational comparison only, never a verdict
  basis; the fault-point total is a system reference here, never a through-current duty basis.
- Bus-total vs through-current discipline is explicit in every note (e.g. F3 net-total 47.37 and
  LINE_Q9 == GRID_Q remote-side contributions rejected as duty basis; F4 fault-point sums rejected).

## 12. Low-earth-fault physics and branch-current doctrine

The 7.27 A F1 LG earth fault is preserved end-to-end: primary 7.27200442799167 A (SOURCE-BACKED import) ->
0.0004848 A secondary (CT 15000/1) -> GEN-51N-SI-STUDY 5 A sensitive study pickup detects with margin
**1.4544 (~1.45)** and operating time ~2.79 s at TMS 0.15. Phase-branch (8414.12 A at F1 LG OUT GEN_Q,
audited as branch-through-current-magnitude with KCL/phasor evidence), zero-sequence
(I0 = 0.00242400147600 kA) and secondary (0.0004848 A) quantities are distinguished in
`phase5_relay_currents.csv`, never conflated. HV-side earth rows (F3/F4/F5 LG/LLG) honestly show
0 A at the generator NER path (delta block: the generator NER carries no HV-fault earth current)
with NO-TRIP outcomes that are never forced PASS. Per-CT minimum-branch detection replaces totals logic:
GEN-51-SI is blind below 17170.8 A on unbalanced generator-zone branches (F1 LG 8414.12 A; F1 LL 8322.14 A;
F1 LLG 8321.45 A NO-TRIP) while the EF element covers LG; LLG residual 3.638 A sits out of the 51N LG-basis
scope and is noted as such.

`phase5_sensitivity.csv` (60 rows, every row scope **SENSITIVITY**) recomputes relay currents,
times and margins under LEGACY-16000/1 **fenced to generator-CT scope only** (never substituted into
non-generator devices): 16k secondary == 15k x 15/16 within 1e-12; with the pickup dial fixed in primary
amperes, legacy-CT times can only stay equal or slow down. Verdict movements under legacy
CT are reported per row. Primary-scope results are never overwritten or merged.

## 14. Source and assumption ledger

determinable/not_determinable) is the mandatory primary/backup table. Detection rule (locked): internal fault
+ maximum terminal branch current at or above the sourced pickup → ASSERTABLE-DETECT (inward-flow
justification: every Phase-4 contribution leg is re-signed toward the fault, so at an internal fault every
zone terminal feeds inward and the differential sum is the magnitude sum); else NOT-DETERMINABLE, never
invented. Live split: ASSERTABLE-DETECT 24 / NOT-DETERMINABLE 24.

- **87G (generator differential, zone G, F1 primary).** ASSERTABLE-DETECT on all 16 F1 rows (8 study + 8

1. **52-1 bay-position assumption.** Mapping Q0 onto the 52-1 plant-outlet breaker is an
   engineering assumption carried in every duty basis string; if the single-line bay assignment
   differs, the through-current path selection must be re-done.
2. **GEN-51-SI unbalanced-branch blindness.** For unbalanced generator-zone faults the GEN_Q branch
   current sits below the 17170.8 A study pickup (F1 LG 8414.12 A; F1 LL 8322.14 A;
   F1 LLG 8321.45 A), so GEN-51-SI returns NO-TRIP on unbalanced generator-zone rows
   while upstream devices still see fault current. Phase-fault backing for unbalanced faults is
   therefore not demonstrated by this study layer (the 87G main above is the assertable cover).
3. **EF thin margin (2.272 A).** GEN-51N-SI-STUDY 5 A detects the 7.27 A F1 LG fault with 2.272 A absolute
   margin (1.454 ratio) at ~2.79 s through a 0.33–0.48 mA secondary path. This is sensitive by
   construction and susceptible to noise, CT error and NER-parameter drift; it is a finding to be
   hardened with measured data, not a field recommendation.
4. **LLG earth fallbacks.** LLG earth pairs have no residual CT in the registry upstream, so they
   resolve as NOT DETERMINABLE or NO-TRIP where GEN-51N sees only 3.63 A < 5 A pickup. Earth backup
   coordination is therefore not demonstrated for LLG faults beyond the LG-basis scope note.

   enters duty, margin or time arithmetic.

9. **Study CT/TMS/SI assumptions labelled.** 1600/1 study CTs carry bay-dependence flags, TMS 0.20/0.15 are
   Status-C initial values, and the SI family is a study choice; changing any of them moves times and margins.
10. **USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC limits.** Four value groups (I> 1.14 A / 17171 A, tdef 3.00 s ??, 87G 0.20/5.0,

parts.text: Documenting a runner bug fix discrepancy and preparing the decision log with root cause and line-number notes.
Populating decision-log entries with dates, rationales, files, and assumption classes for the listed protection settings.

# PHASE5_DECISION_LOG.md

**Project:** Ashuganj South 450 MW CCPP — EEE 306 Power Project
**Phase:** 5b Correction (production-v2 → production-v2-corrected)
**Date (all entries):** 2026-09-19
**Status:** DRAFT per Master Prompt `PHASE 5 CORRECTION` (2026-09-19)
**Freeze boundary:** Phases 2–4 + `results/phase5_protection/` (v1) read-only. v2 work only in `matlab/phase5/phase5b_*` + `results/phase5_protection_v2/`.
**Language convention (binding):** `VERIFIED` / `DERIVED` / `ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION` / `CONDITIONAL_ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION` / `SENSITIVITY` / `USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC` / `NOT_DETERMINABLE` / `LEGACY`. Never promote assumption to verified.

**Assumption-class legend used below:**

| Class | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `VERIFIED` | Directly sourced document value |
| `DERIVED` | Arithmetic from sourced inputs by shipped code |
| `ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION` | Labelled study choice, changeable, never a field rating |
| `CONDITIONAL_ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION` | Provisional value valid only under stated condition |
| `SENSITIVITY` | Fenced recomputation, never PRIMARY |
| `USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC` | User-supplied, PENDING-DOC-INGEST, inverse/field use prohibited |
| `NOT_DETERMINABLE` | MISSING — no value invented |
| `LEGACY` | Superseded basis retained fenced only |

---

## D-001 — Production runner validated wrong suite (bug fix)

**Date:** 2026-09-19
**Decision:** `matlab/phase5/run_phase5b_production.m:189` `[NP,NF]=run_phase5_tests()` → `[NP,NF]=run_phase5b_tests()` + header `:64-68` clarifying `run_phase5b_tests() runs after tables; frozen v1 runner never validates v2`.

**Rationale / systematic-debugging root cause:**

- Symptom: `run_log.txt` at v2 stamp `2026-09-19T18:53:09` records `tests run_phase5_tests: NP=355 NF=0` — STALE, validates frozen v1 framework (`R0,V1–V15`), not Phase-5b implementation (`B01–B13+R0`).
- Reproduce: `matlab -batch "x=fileread('matlab/phase5/run_phase5b_production.m'); assert(contains(x,'[NP, NF] = run_phase5_tests()'),'bug not reproduced')"` → PASS (bug present pre-fix).
- Root cause: copy-paste from `run_phase5_production.m:151` retained v1 runner when `phase5b_*` modules diverged (registry/pickup/effectiveness/duty/TMS/CT). v1 runner was intended only as separate regression, never production proof.
- Fix is minimal (one call + header + `phase5b_writer.m` comment refs `:68,:239,:271,:345` `run_phase5_tests` → `run_phase5b_tests`). No fault/coordination arithmetic changed by this edit.
- Verify: `matlab -batch "x=fileread('matlab/phase5/run_phase5b_production.m'); assert(contains(x,'run_phase5b_tests()')); assert(~contains(x,'[NP, NF] = run_phase5_tests()'))"` → PASS. Note: post-header-expansion the call lands at `:193`; `:189` is the pre-fix report ID retained for traceability.
- Post-fix expected: production `run_log.txt` must show `tests run_phase5b_tests: NP=... NF=...`; `run_phase5_tests` counts (355/0 at v2 stamp, 344/0 v1) remain regression-only.

**Files affected:**

- `matlab/phase5/run_phase5b_production.m:64-68,189 (→:193 after header)`
- `matlab/phase5/phase5b_writer.m:68,239,271,345` (comment/runner-label refs only)
- `matlab/tests/test_phase5b_assumptions.m` (new runner-assert test, §29)
- `results/phase5_protection_v2/run_log.txt`, `manifest.json:testCounts` (regenerated on rerun)

**Assumption class:** N/A — code-correctness fix, no engineering value changed. Test evidence class `DERIVED` (file-content assert).

---

## D-002 — GSUT HV phase CT conflict: installed NOT_DETERMINABLE; 1600/1 study; 1500/1 sensitivity

**Date:** 2026-09-19
**Decision:**

- Installed GSUT HV protection CT ratio/core/tap = `NOT_DETERMINABLE`.
- Study CT = `1600/1` as `ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION` (as-built SLD basis).
- `1500/1` retained fenced `SENSITIVITY` only.
- Pre-correction `SOURCE-BACKED` label on 1600/1 withdrawn.

**Rationale:**

- `docs/validation/conflicting_parameters.md:169`: `GSUT protection CT ratio | 1500/1 (Data Sheet) | 1600/1 (rating plate + Rev 03)`.
- `docs/validation/verified_parameters.md:225`: `GSUT CTs: HV/HV0 T2,T4,T6,T7,T8 = 1600/1 30VA 5P20; HV T1,T3,T5 = 1600/1 5VA 0.2S` — supports 1600/1 as study basis but does not prove installed core/tap/bay wiring.
- Rev 00 Note 3 (preliminary ratings) + two Rev 03 drawings agreeing with rating plates → Rev 03 treated as as-built for study, not proof of field wiring. Manufacturer datasheet 1500/1 cannot be dismissed → genuine conflict, no silent resolution.
- Therefore: no single installed value is assertable; study must pick one labelled assumption and fence the other.

**Docs still needed to resolve installed value (all PENDING):**

1. GSUT rating-plate / CT nameplate photo or `GSUT Nameplate_South.pdf` CT schedule page;
2. As-built CT schematic / wiring / core-allocation (which core T1–T12 feeds 7UT6331 HV-I);
3. Commissioning CT-ratio / polarity / knee-point test sheet.

Until ingest: `ct_source=ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION`, provenance `ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION:GSUT-HV-1600/1-as-built-SLD-study-CT;CONFLICT:manufacturer-1500/1-vs-SLD-1600/1-installed-NOT_DETERMINABLE`.

**Files affected:**

- `matlab/phase5/phase5b_registry.m:114-140` (`ct_source`, `provenance`, bay-dependence flag)
- `matlab/phase5/phase5b_source_ledger.m` (conflict rows)
- `matlab/phase5/phase5b_ct_scope.m`, `phase5b_sensitivity_v2.m` (1500/1 fenced case)
- `PHASE5_ASSUMPTIONS.csv` (conflict rows), `NOT_DETERMINABLE_REGISTER.md`
- `results/phase5_protection_v2/phase5_device_registry.csv`, `phase5_relay_currents.csv`, `phase5_sensitivity.csv` (regenerated)

**Assumption class:** Installed `NOT_DETERMINABLE`; study 1600/1 `ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION`; 1500/1 `SENSITIVITY`; pre-fix `SOURCE-BACKED` withdrawn.

---

## D-003 — GSUT current semantics: 1292.8 A rated vs 1149.7 A anchor vs 1380 A pickup

**Date:** 2026-09-19
**Decision:** Separate three quantities; keep pickup `1380 A` primary (`0.8625 A` sec via 1600/1) but re-base its documentation. Correct registry `rated_A 1150 → 1292.8`.

**Rationale / arithmetic (independently checkable, not code-under-test):**

- `515 MVA` HV rated current (nameplate max cooling stage): `515e6/(sqrt(3)*230e3) = 1292.8 A` — `VERIFIED/DERIVED` from `Generator Data_South.pdf pp.6-7` + `matlab/data/ashuganj_transformers.m` (355/460/515 MVA, 230/22 kV).
- `458 MVA` generator-machine-base anchor: `458e6/(sqrt(3)*230e3) = 1149.7 A` — `DERIVED` anchor for cross-check, not a rating.
- Frozen-flow operating anchor (Phase-4): `GSUT_HV 0.8707726 kA = 870.8 A` from `phase4_ct_data.csv:FL_anchor_kA` — `SOURCE-BACKED` operating point, never a rating.
- Study pickup retained: `1380 A = 1.20 × 1150 A` historic basis preserved numerically; re-documented as `max(1149.7 anchor, operating 870.8)` × 1.20 rule application → `DERIVED + ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION` (1.20× rule itself is assumption). Secondary `1380/1600 = 0.8625 A` `DERIVED`.
- Pre-correction defect: registry `rated_A=1150` conflated an intermediate 1.20 divisor with a rating; report §7 described `1.2×max(rated 1150, anchor 870.8)` without exposing 1292.8/1149.7 split.

**Files affected:**

- `matlab/phase5/phase5b_registry.m:122` (`rated_A`, `rated_basis`, `anchor_A` fields)
- `matlab/phase5/phase5b_pickup.m:158-199` (GSUT branch `refA=max(1149.7,Iload)`, basis strings)
- `matlab/phase5/run_phase5b_production.m:319-360` (assert `1292.8/1149.7/0.8625`)
- `results/phase5_protection_v2/phase5_relay_settings.csv`, `phase5_device_registry.csv`
- `PHASE5_ASSUMPTIONS.csv`, `PHASE5_VALIDATION_REPORT.md` (§ sanity: `458MVA→1149.7`, `515MVA→1292.8`, `1380/1600→0.8625`)

**Assumption class:** `1292.8 VERIFIED/DERIVED`; `1149.7 DERIVED` anchor; `870.8 SOURCE-BACKED` operating anchor; `1380/0.8625 DERIVED + ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION` (1.20× rule).

---

## D-004 — GIS Q0 OC 1500 A conditional pickup + 50 kA conditional duty; final NOT_DETERMINABLE

**Date:** 2026-09-19
**Decision:**

- Study pickup `Q0-51 = 1500 A` primary, `0.9375 A` secondary via 1600/1, `TMS 0.80` — all `CONDITIONAL_ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION`.
- Breaker-duty: conditional layer vs `50 kA` + final verdict `NOT_DETERMINABLE`.
- Pre-correction `1043.94798235109 A (=1.20×LINE_Q9 869.956652 A)` withdrawn from PRIMARY.

**Rationale:**

- No sourced Q0 feeder rated current or 7SS523/51 bay setting exists; `1.20×LINE_Q9` anchor method implies a load-following OC where a busbar-bay OC has no demonstrated load basis. Master central set therefore imposes a round provisional `1500 A` conditional dial to allow coordination/duty sensitivity without implying a rating.
- `1500/1600 = 0.9375 A` `DERIVED` secondary; `TMS 0.80` pairs with D-007 graded set.
- Duty: no source proves Q0 interrupting rating (`rating_kA=NaN`). `50 kA` GIS short-time/equipment withstand (`master §17 SOURCE-BACKED` as equipment datum) must never serve as interrupting rating. Hence two-layer output: (i) `CONDITIONAL` PASS/FAIL vs 50 kA informational reference, (ii) final `NOT_DETERMINABLE FROM AVAILABLE DATA` verdict column. `I_peak_kA` borrowed-shape informational only, never duty input. Q1/Q2/Q9 disconnectors + Q51/Q52/Q8 earthing never duty rows. `52-1 bay-position mapping` remains `ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION`.
- Pre-correction `1043.95 A` moves to audit trail only.

**Files affected:**

- `matlab/phase5/phase5b_pickup.m:201-231` (Q0 branch fixed conditional)
- `matlab/phase5/phase5b_registry.m` (Q0 `tms=0.80`, `provenance=CONDITIONAL_ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION`)
- `matlab/phase5/phase5b_duty.m` (conditional-50kA layer + final NOT_DETERMINABLE)
- `matlab/phase5/run_phase5b_production.m` (assert `1500/0.9375`)
- `results/phase5_protection_v2/phase5_relay_settings.csv`, `phase5_coordination_matrix.csv`, `phase5_breaker_duty.csv`

**Assumption class:** Pickup/TMS/duty-reference `CONDITIONAL_ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION`; final duty verdict `NOT_DETERMINABLE`; equipment 50 kA `SOURCE-BACKED` as withstand datum only.

---

## D-005 — GEN-51N dedicated 20/1 neutral CT; PRIMARY 4 A; 5 A fenced to SENSITIVITY; PRIMARY decontamination

**Date:** 2026-09-19
**Decision:**

- `GEN-51N` CT `15000/1 → 20/1` neutral core (`ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION`).
- PRIMARY setting `4 A` primary / `0.20 A` secondary (`4/20`), `TMS 0.15 SI`.
- Legacy `5 A` sensitive case (`5 A` via 15000/1 = `0.33 mA` sec) moved to `SENSITIVITY` scope only.
- PRIMARY coordination matrix/currents shall contain zero 5 A rows (scope decontamination).

**Rationale / arithmetic:**

- `15000/1` is a phase-CT datum (`B22` protection report); applying it to a neutral EF element forces a `0.4848 mA` secondary path (`7.27200442799167/15000`) with `2.272 A` absolute margin (`7.27 vs 5 A`, ratio `1.4544`) — sensitive by construction, noise/CT-error susceptible, correctly flagged §17 but wrongly in PRIMARY.
- Dedicated `20/1` neutral CT is the master-prompt study provision (no sourced neutral-CT schedule yet): `7.27/20 = 0.3635 A` sec, `4/20 = 0.20 A` pickup-sec, margin `7.27/4 = 1.8175` — still sensitive but physically plausible for a neutral core.
- `5 A` case retained fenced (`10/1, 20/1, 25/1` + `5 A` variants in `phase5b_sensitivity_v2`) for continuity with v2 `2.7925 s @ TMS 0.15` finding; never populates PRIMARY tables/matrices/TCC-study PRIMARY curves.
- Decontamination enforced by scope filter in production driver + writer provenance whitelist; tests assert `no 5A in PRIMARY matrix` + `scope-column audit`.

**Files affected:**

- `matlab/phase5/phase5b_registry.m:88-113` (`GEN-51N ct 20`, neutral-core tag)
- `matlab/phase5/phase5b_pickup.m:89-114` (EF PRIMARY 4 A branch)
- `matlab/phase5/phase5b_sensitivity_v2.m`, `phase5b_sensitivity_scope.m` (5 A + 10/1,20/1,25/1 cases)
- `matlab/phase5/run_phase5b_production.m` (PRIMARY-only coord filter)
- `results/phase5_protection_v2/phase5_relay_settings.csv`, `phase5_relay_currents.csv`, `phase5_coordination_matrix.csv`, `phase5_sensitivity.csv`

**Assumption class:** `20/1 + 4 A/0.20 A/TMS 0.15 ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION`; `5 A SENSITIVITY`; pre-fix `5 A via 15000/1 in PRIMARY` withdrawn. Neutral-core identity itself `NOT_DETERMINABLE` pending CT schedule.

---

## D-006 — TMS graded starting set 0.10 / 0.55 / 0.80 / 0.15; coordination rerun required

**Date:** 2026-09-19
**Decision:** Replace uniform `TMS 0.20 phase / 0.15 EF` with per-device starting values: `GEN-51 0.10 / GSUT-HV-51 0.55 / GIS-Q0-51 0.80 / GEN-51N EF 0.15` (SI family, `CTI 0.30 s`). Values are starting points only; production rerun will move times/margins and may expose new FAILs — reported honestly, never tune-to-pass.

**Rationale:**

- Uniform 0.20 produced as-found `FAIL 20 / NO-TRIP 28 / NO-PAIR 24 / NOT-DET 24 / PASS 0` with upstream-faster inversions (e.g. `F1 LLL GEN→GSUT −0.848 s`, `GSUT→Q0 −0.023 s`) — evidence that a flat TMS cannot grade `GEN→GSUT→Q0` hierarchy.
- Master §36 central set imposes graded starting dials (downstream fastest). Curve constants remain single-sourced in `phase5_curve_info` (`SI k=0.14/α=0.02 STUDY`); `phase5_time`/`phase5_coord` frozen; only TMS dials change.
- `CTI 0.30 s` carried as `ENGINEERING_STUDY_CRITERION` for the corrected rerun (pre-correction ledger claimed `SOURCE-BACKED confirmed`; master correction re-labels pending source re-audit — no numeric change).
- Iteration rule (§26): any post-rerun TMS change logged per-pair with old/new/reason/constraint/margin/class; fault currents/ratings/CTs never manipulated to force PASS.

**Files affected:**

- `matlab/phase5/phase5b_pickup.m:87-88` (per-device TMS)
- `matlab/phase5/phase5b_registry.m` (tms per row)
- `matlab/phase5/run_phase5b_production.m:319-360` (TMS asserts)
- `results/phase5_protection_v2/phase5_relay_settings.csv`, `phase5_coordination_matrix.csv`, `phase5_coordination_margins.csv`, `plots/tcc_study.png` (all regenerated)
- `PHASE5_ASSUMPTIONS.csv` (TMS rows)

**Assumption class:** All four TMS `ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION` (starting values); `CTI 0.30 ENGINEERING_STUDY_CRITERION`; resulting times/margins `DERIVED`.

---

## D-007 — Differential / distance / BF / stator-earth proxies: study labels only, no fabrication

**Date:** 2026-09-19
**Decisions (each: no curve/reach/timer invented; effectiveness relabelled from `ASSERTABLE-DETECT` → `STUDY-DETECTABILITY` / `CONDITIONAL-DETECTABILITY`):**

### D-007a — 87G generator differential

- `Start 0.20 pu × 12019 A = 2403.8 A (0.20×12019)` + high-set `5.0 pu` noted `OFF / NOT_VERIFIED`; `USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC` (7UM622) + master-§21 Status-C corroboration.
- Effectiveness: `STUDY-DETECTABILITY` on F1 inward-flow magnitude observation only; single `0.045 s` derived fast-main clearing applies only where `87G STUDY-DETECTABLE AND 52G/10BAC10 identified`; else `NaN` with reason. No inverse curve ever attached to DT baseline (`use_phase5_time=false`).
- Files: `phase5b_registry.m`, `phase5b_effectiveness.m`, `phase5b_source_ledger.m`.
- Class: `USER_ASSERTED_PENDING_DOC` + `ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION` proxy; timing `DERIVED` (conditional) else `NOT_DETERMINABLE`.

### D-007b — 87T GSUT differential

- `Start 0.30 pu × 1292.8 A = 387.84 A` study proxy, slopes `30/60%` noted as typical-proxy; `7UT6331` presence only, timings `MISSING`.
- Ledger tag `TR-DIFF-0.30pu`; effectiveness `CONDITIONAL-DETECTABILITY` on F2 (GEN 55.05 kA + GSUT_HV 72.11 kA inward vs 387.84 A) with detectability-vs-operation disclaimer (magnitude observation ≠ proven trip).
- Files: `phase5b_registry.m`, `phase5b_effectiveness.m`, `phase5b_branch_phasors.m`.
- Class: `ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION` (study proxy); operation time `NOT_DETERMINABLE`.

### D-007c — 87B GIS busbar differential

- Proxy `0.20 pu / 30% slope` study-only; `7SS523` pickup `NaN`, settings `MISSING`; F3 `NOT-DETERMINABLE` on primary with kA-scale inward observation recorded without asserting detection; backup `GIS-Q0-51` times reported without implying main performance.
- Files: `phase5b_registry.m`, `phase5b_effectiveness.m`.
- Class: `ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION` proxy; detection `NOT_DETERMINABLE`.

### D-007d — 7SD line differential

- Pickup `NaN`, no reach invented; proxy signalling/operate time `50 ms` study-only; F4 `NOT-DETERMINABLE` (B1/B2 magnitude observation, e.g. `F4 LL B1 12.597 / B2 32.008 kA` faulted-phase; `LINE_total` cancellation residual `~1e-13 kA` never used); backup via `B1 GIS-side outfeed` only.
- Files: `phase5b_registry.m`, `phase5b_effectiveness.m`.
- Class: `ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION` (50 ms proxy); protection pickup/reach `NOT_DETERMINABLE`.

### D-007e — 21 distance (generator + South-line)

- No reaches, times, residual compensation, or polygon invented. `LINE-21-note` + generator-21 presence rows, `NOTE`/monitoring-only; effectiveness `NOT_DETERMINABLE`.
- Files: `phase5b_registry.m`, `phase5b_effectiveness.m`.
- Class: `NOT_DETERMINABLE` (no proxy).

### D-007f — 50BF / 86 / trip matrix (associated)

- `50BF` proxies `0.15 s (GIS) / 0.12 s (GEN)` `ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION` for sensitivity discussion only; BF paths/timers `NOT_DETERMINABLE`, never inferred; `86` lockout matrix `NOT_DETERMINABLE`.
- Files: `phase5b_registry.m`, `phase5b_source_ledger.m`.
- Class: timers `ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION` proxy; paths/matrix `NOT_DETERMINABLE`.

| X_N | 2.66 Ω | Generator Data p.2 — report says *estimated* | **ESTIMATED** |

**Internal consistency:** √3·230·50 = 19 918.6 MVA ✔ and 230²/19 919 = 2.656 Ω ✔ — all three numbers derive from I_k″ = 50 kA, which is *exactly* the GIS rated short-time withstand current. That strongly suggests the "grid" was represented at the equipment-design level rather than measured, and using it gives a maximum-strength grid (optimistic voltage support). ## 4. Components
1. **Registry** (`phase5_registry.m`): device_id, device_type, equipment/location, ANSI_function, zone, CT_ratio, CT_source, rated I, Vnom, fault_input_source, pickup, TMS, curve_family, EF pickup/TMS, breaker_ref, upstream/downstream, provenance, status, assumption_class. # 25. 400/230-KV ASHUGANJ GRID BRANCH

The current line/network data and PGCB studies support the following regional topology:

```text
Ashuganj 230 kV
      |
      | 400/230 kV

Ashuganj North 400 kV
      |

      | 69 km
      |
Bhulta 400 kV

The current line-data PDF confirms Ashuganj(N)-Bhulta as **69 km, double circuit, Twin Finch 1113 MCM**. [F2, p.1]

A PGCB study gives an Ashuganj-Bhulta study-case flow of approximately **141.3 MW per circuit** and a **1204 MVA/circuit** rating, useful as a validation point.

---

| Transformer | Rating | Voltage | Study loading |

- 400-kV Ashuganj(N)-Bhulta: 69 km, D/C, Twin Finch 1113

- 2 x 150 MVA Ashuganj 230/132-kV transformers
- 141.3 MW/circuit Ashuganj-Bhulta study flow

## C. Engineering assumptions to use only until actual values are obtained

- line R/X/B and zero-sequence values

# 28. STUDY EXECUTION ORDER

1. Build the **core 22/230-kV South plant model**.
2. Add **12 MW + 5 MVAr auxiliary load**.
3. Add the **230-kV external Thevenin equivalent**.
4. Run base-case load flow at approximately **354 MW gross generation**.
5. Verify the approximate net export target of **342 MW**.
6. Add the 400/230-kV Ashuganj grid transformers.
7. Add the **400-kV Ashuganj North-Bhulta** line and regional network.
8. Run LLL, LG, LL and LLG faults at B01 and B02.
9. Calculate breaker duty from the largest fault currents.
10. Add CT/VT data.
11. Add 7SD522 / 7SS523 functional protection representation.
12. Calculate backup OC/EF coordination and TMS/PS.
13. Add DC/battery/control representation where required by the report.
14. Run sensitivity cases by varying line impedance and external-grid strength.
15. Clearly label all C-values in the final report as **engineering assumptions**.

---

**Do not use the old 15.75-kV generator assumption. Use 22 kV.**

**Do not model "Ghorashal export" as a fixed 250-MW load. Let export emerge from the power-flow solution.**

**Do not combine the 230-kV Ghorasal-Ashuganj 44-km line with the separate 132-kV Ashuganj-Ghorasal 45.3-km line.**

**Do not interpret the 400-kV GIS equipment class as a 420-kV nominal system bus. Use 400 kV nominal with 420-kV-class equipment where appropriate.**

**Do not present any C-value as an actual PGCB/APSCL/OEM value.**

https://opal-rt.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PDOCHS/pages/150307736/Typical%2BElectrical%2BParameters

2. SEL, typical transmission-line sequence parameters - includes a 230-kV overhead-line example:
https://cdn.selinc.com/assets/Literature/Publications/Technical%20Papers/6221_ProtectionACCables_DT_20160425_Web.pdf

3. Conductor reference, Finch 1113 MCM and related ACSR data:
https://www.mega-ex.com/product_general/Phelps_dodge/ALUMINIUM-BARE%20CONDUCTORS/ACSR.pdf

4. BPDB daily generation records - South unit listed as 1 x 360 MW, representative values around 342.01 MW:
https://misc.bpdb.gov.bd/daily-generation?date=11-06-2026

5. PGCB feasibility-study source - Ashuganj-Bhulta study loading/rating and Ashuganj 230/132-kV transformer study data:
https://www.scribd.com/document/875427300/Final-Report-v5-iifc-Pgcb-1

6. Secondary 2019 fault-level compilation used only as preliminary source for Ashuganj South 230-kV fault level:
https://www.scribd.com/document/900735010/Emailing-2019-Fault-Level

---

9: ## C1 — GSUT tap step size
10: | Source | Value |
11: |---|---|
12: | GSUT Data Sheet + Rating plate + Rev 03 SLD | 230 **+8×1.25 % / −16×1.25 %** |
13: | Google Form (APSCL) | 230 −16×**1.15 %** |
14:

21: | Source | Value | Quantity |
22: |---|---|---|
23: | Siemens Generator Data p.1 | **389.30 MW** | Rated P at 458 MVA, pf 0.85, 50 °C cold gas |
24: | Google Form p.2 | **342.01 MW** | "Site De-rated Active Power" |
25: | Prior CYME PSAF `Gener.DBF` `GEN1_DATAA` | 389.3001 MW | PGEN used in the previous model |
26: 
27: **Explanation:** these are **not the same quantity**. 389.30 MW is the generator's electrical rating; 342.01 MW is a site/ambient-de-rated output figure (Ashuganj max ambient 46.8 °C per the nameplate, well above the 50 °C-cold-gas rating point). Neither is a measured dispatch. Both preserved.
28: **Effect:** **BLOCKING** — the load-flow dispatch must be chosen. See question **Q2**.

32: ## C3 — Generator apparent power rating
33: | Source | Value | Condition |
34: |---|---|---|
35: | Name plate + Rev 03 SLD ×2 | **458 MVA** | cold gas 50 °C — the rating |
36: | Generator Data p.1 | 518 MVA (S_max) | cold gas 30 °C |
37: | Rev 00 SLD (GHESA, 17.05.2013) | 450 MVA | *preliminary* per its own Note 3 |
38: | Rev 00 SLD generator CT | 16000/1 A | vs Rev 03 **15000/1 A** |
39: 
40: **Explanation:** 458 and 518 MVA are the same machine at two different cooling-gas temperatures — a condition difference, not a conflict. 450 MVA is a superseded preliminary value; the Rev 00 drawing states its own ratings are preliminary. 458 MVA is confirmed by the released rating plate and by two independent Rev 03 drawings.
41: **Effect:** MATERIAL, resolved by documented supersession + condition. Model base = 458 MVA; 518 MVA retained as the 30 °C capability; 450 MVA retained as historical.
42: 
43: ---
