187:             if isfinite(aI) && isfinite(bI) && aI >= I87T_START_A && bI >= I87T_START_A
188:                 pa = 'CONDITIONAL-DETECTABILITY';
189:                 tp = NaN;
190:                 tNote = sprintf(['primary-GSUT-87T-CONDITIONAL-DETECTABILITY-internal-' ...
191:                     'transformer-fault-inward-GEN-%.1fA-plus-GSUT_HV-%.1fA-' ...
192:                     'vs-start-0.30pu-x-Siemens-nameplate-HV-base-%.1fA-=%.2fA-' ...
193:                     'master-S21-Status-C-starting-assumption-applied-to-Siemens-' ...
194:                     'nameplate-base-ledger-TR-DIFF-0.30pu;' ...
195:                     'primary_time-NaN-GSUT-87T-7UT6331-settings-missing-' ...
196:                     'timing-NOT-DETERMINABLE-never-45ms'], aI, bI, GSUT_HV_BASE_A, I87T_START_A);
197:             else
198:                 pa = 'NOT-DETERMINABLE';
199:                 tp = NaN;
200:                 tNote = sprintf(['primary-GSUT-87T-NOT-DETERMINABLE-vs-start-' ...
201:                     '0.30pu-x-Siemens-nameplate-HV-base-%.1fA-=%.2fA-' ...
202:                     'master-S21-Status-C-starting-assumption-applied-to-Siemens-' ...
203:                     'nameplate-base-ledger-TR-DIFF-0.30pu-' ...
204:                     'inward-GEN-%.3gA-GSUT_HV-%.3gA;' ...
205:                     'primary_time-NaN-GSUT-87T-settings-missing'], GSUT_HV_BASE_A, I87T_START_A, aI, bI);
206:             end
207:         case 'F3'
208:             pf = 'GIS-87B';
209:             aI = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'GSUT_HV');
210:             bI = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'LINE_total');
211:             cI = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'GRID');
212:             psrc = ['SOURCE-BACKED:PROT-7SS523-presence-settings-MISSING-' ...
213:                 'differential-timing-NOT-DETERMINABLE'];
214:             cts = ['SOURCE-BACKED:GIS-bay-1600/1-5P20-30VA-' ...
215:                 'ledger-GIS-bay-1600/1-study-CT'];
216:             % No sourced 7SS523 pickup exists (registry pickup NaN): never assert;
217:             % the reason below reports the live inward magnitudes with no detection.
218:             pa = 'NOT-DETERMINABLE';

221:                 '7SS523-pickup-registry-pickup-NaN-presence-only-kA-scale-' ...
222:                 'magnitude-observation-inward-GSUT_HV-%.1fA-plus-LINE-%.1fA-' ...
223:                 'plus-GRID-%.1fA-no-detection-asserted;' ...
224:                 'primary_time-NaN-GIS-87B-7SS523-settings-missing-' ...
225:                 'timing-NOT-DETERMINABLE-never-45ms'], aI, bI, cI);
226:         case 'F4'
227:             pf = 'LINE-7SD';
228:             aI = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'LINE_B1');
229:             bI = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'LINE_B2');
230:             psrc = ['SOURCE-BACKED:PROT-7SD5221x2-2x7SD5221-presence-' ...
231:                 'settings-MISSING-differential-timing-NOT-DETERMINABLE'];
232:             cts = ['SOURCE-BACKED:GIS-bay-1600/1-5P20-30VA-' ...
233:                 'ledger-GIS-bay-1600/1-study-CT'];
234:             % No sourced 7SD5221 pickup exists (registry pickup NaN): never assert;
235:             % the reason below reports the live section magnitudes with no detection.
236:             pa = 'NOT-DETERMINABLE';
237:             tp = NaN;
238:             tNote = sprintf(['primary-LINE-7SD-NOT-DETERMINABLE-no-sourced-' ...
239:                 '7SD5221-pickup-registry-pickup-NaN-presence-only-kA-scale-' ...
240:                 'magnitude-observation-inward-LINE_B1-GIS-side-%.1fA-plus-' ...
241:                 'LINE_B2-remote-side-%.1fA-no-detection-asserted;' ...
242:                 'primary_time-NaN-LINE-7SD-7SD5221x2-settings-missing-' ...
243:                 'timing-NOT-DETERMINABLE-never-45ms'], aI, bI);
244:         otherwise  % F5: remote, out-of-zone, no zone primary mapped
245:             pf = 'NONE-no-zone-primary-mapped';
246:             pa = 'NOT-DETERMINABLE';
247:             tp = NaN;

249:                 'fault-no-zone-primary-mapped-no-87-class-in-zone;' ...
250:                 'primary_time-NaN-no-primary-mapped'];
251:             psrc = 'NONE-no-zone-primary-mapped-out-of-zone-no-setting-source';
252:             cts = ['SOURCE-BACKED:GIS-bay-1600/1-5P20-30VA-' ...
253:                 'ledger-GIS-bay-1600/1-study-CT'];

256:     % === STUDY BACKUP (v2 C4 inputs via phase5b_pickup; frozen operating time) ===
257:     if strcmp(loc, 'F1') && strcmp(typ, 'LG')

259:         dev = efD;

262:         scopeNote = sprintf(['backup-EF-4A-PRIMARY-via-20/1-LG-basis-must-detect-F1-LG-3I0-%.3fA;' ...
263:             'phase-element-blind-at-F1-LG-C6-EF-element-covers'], I);

266:         dev = genD;

268:         I = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'GEN');

272:         dev = gsutD;

275:         scopeNote = sprintf('backup-phase-GSUT_HV-terminal-faulted-phase-%.1fA', I);
276:     elseif strcmp(loc, 'F4')

278:         dev = gisD;

280:         I = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, 'LINE_B1');  % GIS-side section outfeed, never the cancellation residual
281:         scopeNote = sprintf(['backup-via-LINE_B1-GIS-side-outfeed-%.1fA-' ...

285:         dev = gisD;
286:         Iload = ILOAD_GIS;

288:         scopeNote = sprintf('backup-via-LINE_total-through-convention-%.1fA', I);

294:     end

319:         llgNote = '';
320:     end

322:         ndText = [tNote ';' bNote];

324:         ndText = [tNote ';' bNote ';' llgNote];

329:     cids{end+1, 1} = cs; %#ok<AGROW>

383: function s = aschar(v)
384: %ASCHAR  Cell/string scalar to trimmed char.
385: if isstring(v) && isscalar(v)
386:     v = char(v);
387: end
388: if iscell(v) && isscalar(v)
389:     v = v{1};
390:     if isstring(v) && isscalar(v)
391:         v = char(v);
392:     end
393: end

397: function I = bget(B, cs, loc, typ, leg)
398: %BEGET  Faulted-phase branch magnitude (A) for one B-table leg; NaN if absent.
399: hit = strcmp(B.caseID, cs) & strcmp(B.location, loc) ...
400:     & strcmp(B.fault_type, typ) & strcmp(B.leg, leg);
401: if sum(hit) == 1
402:     I = double(B.Ibranch_faulted_A(hit));
403: else
404:     I = NaN;
405: end
406: end

408: function d = reqdev(devices, id)
409: %REQDEV  Registry row by device_id or phase5b-prefixed error.
410: d = findDevice(devices, id);
411: if isempty(d)
412:     error('phase5b_effectiveness:devices', 'devices missing required registry row %s.', id);
413: end
414: end

416: function d = findDevice(devices, id)
417: %FINDDEVICE  First registry row matching device_id (empty if absent).
418: d = [];
419: for k = 1:numel(devices)
420:     v = devices(k).device_id;
421:     if isstring(v) && isscalar(v)
422:         v = char(v);
423:     end
424:     if ischar(v) && strcmp(strtrim(v), id)
425:         d = devices(k);
426:         return;
427:     end
428: end
429: end

431: function d = devrow(devices, id)

189: function [has52, rating52, ratingSrc] = parse52(ratings)

191: % Only breaker_ref '52G' accepted: Q0 errors (50 kA withstand must never

208:         error('phase5b_duty:ratings', 'ratings struct needs fields breaker_ref, rating_kA, source.');
209:     end
210:     refs = cell(numel(ratings), 1); vals = NaN(numel(ratings), 1); srcs = cell(numel(ratings), 1);
211:     for k = 1:numel(ratings)
212:         refs{k} = char(ratings(k).breaker_ref);
213:         vals(k) = double(ratings(k).rating_kA);
214:         srcs{k} = char(ratings(k).source);
215:     end
216: else

218: end
219: for k = 1:numel(refs)

223:             'EQUIPMENT WITHSTAND (master S17), never a breaker_interrupting_rating; ' ...
224:             'Q0 interrupting stays NOT DETERMINABLE.']);
225:     end
226:     if any(strcmp(r, {'Q1', 'Q2', 'Q9', 'Q51', 'Q52', 'Q8'}))
227:         error('phase5b_duty:rating', ['breaker_ref %s is a disconnector/earthing device, ' ...
228:             'never duty (only Q0 52-1 and 52G are duty-eligible).'], r);

233: end

237: end

239:     has52 = true; rating52 = vals(hit); ratingSrc = strtrim(srcs{hit});

1: function M = phase5b_mindetect(T40, devices)
2: %PHASE5B_MINDETECT  Per-CT min-detect over zone-relevant branch currents (Phase-5b Task C6).
3: %   M = PHASE5B_MINDETECT(T40, devices) replaces the V9 totals-based
4: %   min-detect with one struct row per (device, element in
5: %   phase/residual/negseq). Each row carries the minimum BRANCH current
6: %   over zone-relevant faults, the C4 study pickup (via phase5b_pickup),
7: %   the margin (min_branch_A / pickup_A) and a verdict:
8: %     margin >= 1               -> 'DETECT'
9: %     margin <  1 (determinable) -> 'BLIND-SPOT-HONEST' (non-PASS, never tuned)
10: %     not determinable           -> 'NOT-DETERMINABLE' (honest, never invented)
11: %
12: %   Row fields (locked): device_id, element, zone_locs, branch_tag,
13: %   n_zone, n_used, min_branch_A, min_loc, min_type, min_case, pickup_A,
14: %   pickup_src, margin, verdict, determinable, reason.
15: %
16: %   Zone relevance (locked): GEN devices <- F1/F2 rows (GEN_Q branch leg
17: %   for phase; 3I0 = 3x NER series leg for residual; negseq branch NOT
18: %   DETERMINABLE); GSUT-HV <- F1/F2/F3 rows (GSUT_HV leg); GIS-Q0 <-
19: %   F3/F4/F5 rows (LINE_Q9 through-convention magnitude: |leg_LINE_total|
20: %   for non-F4 rows; F4 rows use the same column with the documented
21: %   caveat that toward-fault B1+B2 sums both infeeds, so the F4 value
22: %   overstates the GIS outfeed — the GIS min binds at F5 regardless).
23: %
24: %   Branch-current doctrine (hardened): ONLY leg_* columns of the
25: %   phase5_import T40 join are read (C5-pinned branch-through-current
26: %   semantics). Fault totals are never a proxy for relay current: no
27: %   fault-point magnitude column is referenced anywhere below.
28: %
29: %   Stored production legs are |Ia| magnitudes only (phase4_handoff
30: %   legRow). Phase-element candidate types are therefore LLL (symmetric:
31: %   all phases equal |Ia|) and LG (A-phase faulted; B/C ~ 0 per the
32: %   phase4 LG_branch0 diagnostic): on LL/LLG rows the stored |Ia| is the
33: %   UNFAULTED-phase current and understates what B/C phase elements see,
34: %   so LL/LLG phase coverage is recorded NOT-DETERMINABLE-by-type
35: %   (counted in the reason string, never silently dropped). Residual
36: %   scope is the LG sensitivity-defining fault (C4 51N study basis
37: %   must-detect-F1-LG); LLG residual rows are observed-but-out-of-scope
38: %   and their observed 3I0 minimum is quoted in the reason string as a
39: %   flagged limitation, never as a verdict input. Negseq branch I2 is
40: %   unavailable in T40/production CSVs; fault-point sequence current is
41: %   a total and is never derived per the branch-current doctrine, so
42: %   every negseq row is NOT-DETERMINABLE.
43: %
44: %   Pickups come from the phase5b_pickup C4 rules (registry carries NaN +
45: %   rule tags; nothing hard-coded here). Load anchors passed to the
46: %   pickup engine are locked study constants: GEN devices Imax 14309 A
47: %   (ledger GEN-Imax-14309); GSUT-HV-51 GSUT_HV flow anchor 870.7726 A
48: %   (rule takes max with rated 1150 A, so 1380 A); GIS-Q0-51 LINE_Q9 flow
49: %   anchor 869.9567 A; GEN-51N study 0 A (fixed 5 A retained case). The
50: %   Imin argument is the computed branch minimum itself (settings are
51: %   load-based, so there is no circularity; validation margins stay
52: %   consistent). Devices whose pickup errors (DISABLED high-set, notes,
53: %   boundaries) yield NOT-DETERMINABLE rows quoting the engine reason.
54: %
55: %   All errors are 'phase5b'-prefixed.
56: if nargin ~= 2
57:     error('phase5b_mindetect:args', 'usage: M = phase5b_mindetect(T40, devices).');
58: end
59: if ~istable(T40) || height(T40) < 1
60:     error('phase5b_mindetect:schema', 'T40 must be a non-empty table (phase5_import backbone).');
61: end
62: need = {'fault_location', 'fault_type', 'caseID', 'leg_GEN_kA', ...
63:     'leg_GSUT_HV_kA', 'leg_LINE_total_kA', 'leg_NER_earth_kA'};
64: for k = 1:numel(need)
65:     if ~any(strcmp(T40.Properties.VariableNames, need{k}))
66:         error('phase5b_mindetect:schema', 'T40 missing required branch column %s.', need{k});
67:     end
68: end
69: if ~isstruct(devices) || isempty(devices) || ~isfield(devices, 'device_id')
70:     error('phase5b_mindetect:devices', 'devices must be a non-empty struct array with device_id (registry rows).');
71: end
72: 
73: ELS = {'phase', 'residual', 'negseq'};
74: M = repmat(emptyRow(), 0, 1);
75: for d = 1:numel(devices)
76:     dev = devices(d);
77:     idraw = dev.device_id;
78:     if isstring(idraw) && isscalar(idraw)
79:         idraw = char(idraw);
80:     end
81:     if ~ischar(idraw) || isempty(strtrim(idraw))
82:         error('phase5b_mindetect:devices', 'devices(%d).device_id must be non-empty char.', d);
83:     end
84:     id = strtrim(idraw);
85:     [zone, legCol, zoneTag] = zoneOf(id);
86:     kind = kindOf(dev, id);
87:     for e = 1:numel(ELS)
88:         M(end + 1, 1) = buildRow(T40, dev, id, ELS{e}, zone, legCol, zoneTag, kind); %#ok<AGROW>
89:     end
90: end
91: end

94: r = struct('device_id', '', 'element', '', 'zone_locs', '', ...
95:     'branch_tag', '', 'n_zone', NaN, 'n_used', NaN, 'min_branch_A', NaN, ...

<skill_content name="verification-before-completion">
# Skill: verification-before-completion

# Verification Before Completion

## Overview

**Core principle:** Evidence before claims, always.

**Violating the letter of this rule is violating the spirit of this rule.**

## The Iron Law

```
NO COMPLETION CLAIMS WITHOUT FRESH VERIFICATION EVIDENCE
```

If you haven't run the verification command in this message, you cannot claim it passes.

## The Gate Function

```
BEFORE claiming any status or expressing satisfaction:

1. IDENTIFY: What command proves this claim?
2. RUN: Execute the FULL command (fresh, complete)
3. READ: Full output, check exit code, count failures
4. VERIFY: Does output confirm the claim?
   - If NO: State actual status with evidence
   - If YES: State claim WITH evidence
5. ONLY THEN: Make the claim

Skip any step = lying, not verifying
```

## Common Failures

| Claim | Requires | Not Sufficient |
|-------|----------|----------------|
| Tests pass | Test command output: 0 failures | Previous run, "should pass" |
| Linter clean | Linter output: 0 errors | Partial check, extrapolation |
| Build succeeds | Build command: exit 0 | Linter passing, logs look good |
| Bug fixed | Test original symptom: passes | Code changed, assumed fixed |
| Regression test works | Red-green cycle verified | Test passes once |
| Agent completed | VCS diff shows changes | Agent reports "success" |
| Requirements met | Line-by-line checklist | Tests passing |

## Red Flags - STOP

- Using "should", "probably", "seems to"
- Expressing satisfaction before verification ("Great!", "Perfect!", "Done!", etc.)
- About to commit/push/PR without verification
- Trusting agent success reports
- Relying on partial verification
- Thinking "just this once"
- Tired and wanting work over
- **ANY wording implying success without having run verification**

## Rationalization Prevention

| Excuse | Reality |
|--------|---------|
| "Should work now" | RUN the verification |
| "I'm confident" | Confidence ≠ evidence |
| "Just this once" | No exceptions |
| "Linter passed" | Linter ≠ compiler |
| "Agent said success" | Verify independently |
| "I'm tired" | Exhaustion ≠ excuse |
| "Partial check is enough" | Partial proves nothing |
| "Different words so rule doesn't apply" | Spirit over letter |

## Key Patterns

**Tests:**
```
✅ [Run test command] [See: 34/34 pass] "All tests pass"
❌ "Should pass now" / "Looks correct"
```

**Regression tests (TDD Red-Green):**
```
✅ Write → Run (pass) → Revert fix → Run (MUST FAIL) → Restore → Run (pass)
❌ "I've written a regression test" (without red-green verification)
```

**Build:**
```
✅ [Run build] [See: exit 0] "Build passes"
❌ "Linter passed" (linter doesn't check compilation)
```

**Requirements:**
```
✅ Re-read plan → Create checklist → Verify each → Report gaps or completion
❌ "Tests pass, phase complete"
```

**Agent delegation:**
```
✅ Agent reports success → Check VCS diff → Verify changes → Report actual state
❌ Trust agent report
```

## When To Apply

**ALWAYS before:**
- ANY variation of success/completion claims
- ANY expression of satisfaction
- ANY positive statement about work state
- Committing, PR creation, task completion
- Moving to next task
- Delegating to agents

**Rule applies to:**
- Exact phrases
- Paraphrases and synonyms
- Implications of success
- ANY communication suggesting completion/correctness
